method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

themes.title: Contract-centred billing model
themes.description: Billing route, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s replaced by holders, dated Contract versions, standalone lines, one No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review, authorisation snapshot. XL, split into model, versioning screens, picker.

themes.title: Pricing, units and modifiers
themes.description: Price, rate and discount held on the Procedure with no reason, Contract flag gating anaesthetist, no-charge invoice, modifier split above four, RVG hidden-key master, modifier records with explanations, age pre-applied, out-of-range warns, completion rules reworked. XL.

themes.title: Hospital intake matching screen
themes.description: No review-and-merge screen exists; HL7/FHIR and PDF rows auto-apply. Need staged rows, match/create/Draft List/reject, per-row change type, differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits until AUTHORISED. XL.

themes.title: NHI mandatory and text as received
themes.description: Remove provisional patients and NHI pending; waiting-for-NHI queue; procedure text kept per source with time; separate invoice description. M, bundled with intake.

themes.title: Prepayment and holding account
themes.description: Prepaid Contract triggers prepayment at line price, admin approval with letter, payable to holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Anaesthetist currently paid before the procedure. XL.

themes.title: Events, additional invoices and credit notes
themes.description: Post-op addendum Booking replaced by events on the Procedure, free-form additional invoices, credit then rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly payment cycle. XL.

themes.title: Edit window until AUTHORISED and anaesthetist views
themes.description: Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED, List leaves main view at AUTHORISED, balances show invoices immediately, search and scroll-back. M.

themes.title: OQ-81 reversal: unavailability is never a conflict
themes.description: Remove availability conflict kind, make closed sessions non-assignable by the office, route sickness through return-or-assign to a Draft List. M to L, independent.

themes.title: Single-Booking move and notification pool
themes.description: Anaesthetist moves one Booking into a new List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an ask-the-office source. M.

themes.title: Payer, insurer, balances and warnings
themes.description: Payer name and email on the Booking, insurer and approval number on the Booking, patient balance alerts, remaining warning rules, ledger positions, split as a Booking action. L, after Contract rework.

themes.title: Profile, reporting and admin polish
themes.description: Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing ordering, audit exclusions, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. M, mostly small.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations:
EP-01's three in-scope items split cleanly. US-01.1.1 is correctly Matches: the Slot canvas (AM and PM per active anaesthetist, free default, leave then series then recurring, clash to Draft List, one List per Slot, 4-month roll-forward) is implemented and visible in the Admin Day grid and both anaesthetist list screens. The two gaps, US-01.1.5 (split a session into A and B Lists, Proposed) and US-01.1.6 (out-of-hours List, Confirmed), are both new from the 5 November meeting and both break the prototype's core assumptions that Session is 'AM' | 'PM', that a day has exactly two Slots, and that a Slot holds at most one List (AssignedList.slotId, SlotView.list, listInSlot, slotOccupied guards, Admin ruler 07:00 to 18:00, List times derived from the Slot via timesForList).

Build order: do US-01.1.6 first (Confirmed). It is likely smaller as a standalone after-PM List kind with its own start time than as a widened Session union, but it needs a design decision first (third Slot kind or a List outside Slots; who creates it; finder treatment). US-01.1.5 is only Proposed and should wait for agreement with Donald and Greg or be built behind a clearly marked option. It changes the Slot to List relation to 0..2 and the domain-model ERD line must change with it.

Dependencies: US-01.1.4 (default and per-half times), US-01.4.2 (availability finder treatment of evening and splits), US-01.3.1 (pairing rule: one surgeon and hospital per List), US-01.3.2 (recurring bookings stay unsplit), FT-01.6 (can a Draft List be one half), US-13.6.6 (surgeon specialties narrow Contracts per List), and the billing and submit flows (Bookings billed as on any other List). A PERSIST_VERSION bump and a seed example are needed for either. Demo script S1 to S5 beats are unaffected if the features are additive, but S1 and S2 read the Admin Day grid and the anaesthetist's day, so their screenshots and data-shot hooks (DayGrid, SlotDrawer) must be rechecked; both features need new presenter-guide beats.

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations: Structural: the prototype has one append-only audit trail (mutate.ts) and a shared HistorySheet reachable from every Booking, so US-02.5.5 and most of US-02.5.8 are in place. Every gap sits downstream of the intake rebuild. There is no hospital-list application path (the matching screen, FT-02.1 / Phase 33, is not built; HL7/FHIR S12 to S15 are interim stand-ins now Future scope), no unmatched queue (US-02.1.4, US-11.1.5), no stubs, and no multi-user office (US-13.5.1; one hard-coded actor, Kirsty W.). The procedure text is the one real contradiction on the history side: EditProcedureSheet still lets people hand-edit it, which US-02.5.7 now forbids, and feed updates never replace it. The prototype also actively contradicts the stub rule: createBooking/upsertPatient turns a no-NHI incoming row into a Booking with a provisional Patient (and the seed carries one, shown as 'NHI pending'), against US-11.1.4 and US-02.6.1. Dependencies: US-02.5.7/02.5.8 depend on the matching screen (hospital text replacing rooms' text, hospital-sourced history entry) and US-03.1.9 (text shown with the Contract and RVG choice); US-02.6.1/02.6.3 depend on US-11.1.4 and US-11.1.5; US-02.6.3 depends on US-02.6.1. The old contract model (governingContractId) will be reworked by EP-04, so US-02.5.5's Contract-selection history needs rechecking then. Status caveats: 02.5.5 is Proposed; 02.5.7, 02.5.8, 02.6.1 and 02.6.3 are Verify (agreed in the room or answered by Donald only, not yet seen by Greg/Vanessa/Ben as applicable), so wording may still move. Demo-script impact: S1 (feed messages MSG-STG-1001 to 1004, 1010) and S4 (Exceptions) change when hospital updates replace procedure text and no-NHI rows become stubs; any beat that hand-edits an operation via 'Edit operation' changes because hand edits are removed.

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations: EP-03 capture UI is largely the July build on the old model: billing route plus governing Contract Type 1/2/3, ASA-seeded modifier units, a mandatory override reason on any Contract, the anaesthetist seeing no price on the Booking (the web List table is the exception), and the 'post-op addendum' (labelled 'Add post-op event') as a linked Booking on a new List. Verifier changes: FT-03.3, US-03.3.3 and US-03.6.1 moved from Partial to Contradicts because the prototype asks for times, modifiers or in-range units on fixed-price Contracts and blocks completion on things the catalogue says should not block. The Matches items (FT-03.2, US-03.2.1, US-03.1.4) were re-checked and upheld. Caveat on US-03.2.1: the equal modifier split above 4 units (US-05.3.1) is not implemented, and no UI sets which Procedure is primary. These are for the EP-05 review. The new Contract-on-Procedure model (EP-04 pricing kind, per-Contract override flag, No contract RVG/Fixed fallbacks, default RVG code, step rail, filtered Contract list US-04.3.2, prepaid Contracts non-editable) is a hard prerequisite for FT-03.4, US-03.4.1, US-03.3.9, US-03.3.3, US-03.5.1, US-03.5.2, US-03.3.1 and US-03.6.1, so schedule them after the EP-04 contract phases. Also change the anaesthetist edit window to AUTHORISED in lifecycle.editRefusal, with an office-review flag on anaesthetist changes (US-07.2.2). Events (FT-03.7, US-03.1.10, US-03.7.4) depend on EP-08 additional invoices, credit notes and invoice description (US-08.4.6), EP-05 (US-05.5.2 ACC pre-op) and the EP-07 billing run for next-run bundling. The addendum code (addPostOpAddendum, 'INTERIM until Phase 38b') should be retired. The out-of-range base-units warning depends on the US-13.7.1 warning routine, where only prepaymentUnpaid exists. Procedure-text replacement (US-02.5.7) and invoice description (US-08.4.6) feed US-03.1.9. Demo-guide impact: S1 Beat 3 says the anaesthetist 'sees no running fee' and walks ASA, modifiers and Start/Finish, so US-03.3.10, the ASA seed removal (US-03.3.4) and the Contract-driven form collapse (US-03.3.9) change its script; S2 Beats 2 and 4 are affected by Contract-on-Procedure and the edit window; S4 Beat 2 'post-op addendum' is replaced by events; S4 Beat 1 gains the prepaid amount (US-03.1.8). Bump PERSIST_VERSION when the seed gains pricing kinds, the override flag, default RVG code or events.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations:
EP-04 is the largest structural gap between catalogue and prototype. The prototype is entirely on the July Type 1/2/3 Contract model and the catalogue replaces it with the flat Contract model (AR-58). Because the old model is implemented, most graded stories are Contradicts, not Missing. Verification corrected three gradings: US-04.2.14 Partial to Contradicts (override is allowed on fixed-price items and individual scope is the older precedence reading), US-04.3.3 Contradicts to Partial (price, billed-to-payer and override outcomes already match for a self-funded Booking with no contract), and US-04.3.8 Missing to Contradicts (the office route control plus unfiltered Contract select is an older equivalent, with the route stored on the Procedure).

Structural changes:
- Contract shape: remove type 1/2/3, holderType/holderId, scope, isDefault, permitsIndividualArrangement, effectiveFrom/To and type2Detail. Add a Party reference, a bills-holder-or-payer setting, linked surgeons and at most one linked anaesthetist, a funding tag, specialties, a pricing kind (5), a per-Contract anaesthetist-override flag (RVG-priced only), an AA code, a holder reference code, an invoice description, a default RVG code, a prepaid flag and an Active/Disabled status; kind and prepaid fixed after creation.
- New masters: Party (merging insurers, organisations and the hospital pointer, adding funders, AA and anaesthetists), funding tag list (US-13.4.5), specialty list (US-13.4.4), price ranges on fixed prices.
- Retire: the protected per-hospital and per-insurer default Type 1 contracts (auto-created by createHospital and setInsurerDirectClaims), Insurer.acceptsDirectClaims, deleteContract, the individual-anaesthetist scope precedence and the rate x time Method 3 gate. Replace with the AA-held 'No contract · RVG' plus system-made open-price fallbacks.
- Procedure: governingContractId becomes mandatory with no 'None' option. billingRoute, insurerId, patientPaymentCategory and billablePartyId stop being set directly; the destination is derived from the Contract and the payer is on the Booking (EP-11). This ripples through validateBookingForBilling, invoiceBuild.resolveContractForProcedure and counterpartyForProcedure, OfficeBillingSetup, EditBillingSetupSheet, ManualBookingForm, EditProcedureSheet, the funder allocation sheet, all seeded Bookings (bookings.ts references the default Type 1s directly) and scenario markers.
- Contract picker: a new office step rail (working design in contract-picker-mock/) mirrored on mobile, web and PWA for the anaesthetist, with 'Needs an invoice destination', Suggested path, typed search and the 'Other price' toggle.
- Override: the OverrideCard has no contract gating and a mandatory reason; it must follow the per-Contract setting, refuse fixed and prepaid, and drop the reason.
- A Procedure-level pricing snapshot at AUTHORISED must be stored (today only invoice-line rate detail exists), and a missing price must block AUTHORISED.
- PERSIST_VERSION must be bumped with the seed change.

Dependencies on other epics: EP-03 (US-03.4.1 anaesthetist changes Contract, US-03.5.1 adjustment, US-03.3.9 RVG detail), EP-05 (US-05.2.8 Needs a price, US-05.4.2 office price change, US-05.2.6 and US-05.4.3 rate and discount lines, US-05.5.1 funding tag), EP-06 (prepaid Contract starts the prepayment), EP-07 (US-07.2.2 review flag for a Contract not offered; OQ-135 for a Disabled Contract), EP-08 (invoice layout and delivery, credit note and re-issue, additional invoices and events), EP-11 (US-11.2.2 payer on the Booking, US-11.4.3 funder and approval number), EP-13 (US-13.4.3 cutover load, US-13.4.4 specialties, US-13.4.5 funding tags, US-13.6.6 surgeon specialty).

Open questions OQ-133, OQ-135, OQ-114, OQ-136, OQ-122 do not block the build: the text says no affected-Procedures list and delivery is email or post.

Scripted demo beats affected: S3 Beat 1 (invoice numbers and amounts depend on seeded Contracts and routes); S4 Beat 3 (billing-failure trigger end-dates the COS ACC Type 2 contract, registry.ts:364, which cannot exist under Active/Disabled, so a new failure cause such as a fixed price with no range on the List date, shown as 'Needs a price', is needed); S5 Beat 4 (contract end-dating of Health NZ agreed rate, also narrated in the DemoControlPanel S5 scenario text, becomes 'a rate change means a new Contract; raised invoices are unchanged'); S4 Beats 1 and 2 (prepaid becomes a Contract setting); S1 Beat 2 and S2 Beat 2 (office billing setup uses the step rail). Sequence the XL and L items first: model rewrite (US-04.1.1), Party (US-04.1.5), who-billed and offered-on-List (US-04.2.1, US-04.3.2) and the step rail (US-04.3.8); AA code, reference code, specialty and funding-tag items are mostly seed and admin-form work (S to M) once the Contract shape exists.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: EP-05 is largely built on the OLD RFP reading: Contract Type 1/2/3, Method 3 rate x time lines, override with mandatory reason in three shapes, additional procedure = time units only, Type 3 BTM fallback. Verification regraded two items (US-05.2.6 and US-05.2.8, both Partial to Contradicts) and added concrete wrong behaviours: a $0 total raises no invoice (requirement: a no-charge invoice), OverrideCard refuses a $0 charge, a prepaid deposit is netted off a recomputed fee so a difference invoice is raised automatically, a Contract change does not clear a typed price, and price changes are never flagged at review (reviewFlags.ts has no such flag). Matches stand only for US-05.2.1 (per-anaesthetist unit value, Contract rate and discount) and US-05.2.7 (GST held ex and added at the foot). Structural dependencies: pricing kinds, price ranges, open price and 'Needs a price' depend on the EP-04 flat Contract rework (and the OQ-133 backdating answer); the ACC funding tag on US-04.2.17; the primary-procedure flag on US-03.2.1; held-price rules on prepayment (EP-06) and the AUTHORISED snapshot (US-04.3.5). The domain-model delta already lists DM-13 (RVG group), DM-14 (single typed price), DM-15 (multi-procedure) and DM-50; suggested order is DM-13, then DM-50 with DM-14, then DM-15. Admin RVG and Modifier screens are view only; RVG codes are keyed by code, so the duplicate-code type-ahead cannot be shown without a hidden system key. Pure billing code in domain/billing/fee.ts means many changes are one-place edits, with a PERSIST_VERSION bump for seed or shape changes. Demo-guide impact: S4 Beat 1 invoice figures (split Booking totals) and the bariatric Type 3 Booking change if the modifier split, 'Needs a price' or optional times alter totals; S4 Beat 4 contract effective-dating conflicts with the undated-rate rule; S1/S2 override narration ('mandatory reason') changes. Date-driven behaviours (backdated price range, held prices) need demo buttons. No OutOfScope items.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations:
US-07.2.1 is the one hard contradiction. The prototype treats SUBMITTED as read-only for the anaesthetist in the store (editRefusal), shared Booking detail (canEdit), both anaesthetist apps, the submit confirm copy, the web 'Submitted to office' state and the demo-guide persona text, and the tests assert it. Reversing it touches all of these, plus a 'changed since submit' hint at Admin review. The Done filter also keeps a List until billed rather than until authorised. List moves on SUBMITTED Lists (US-07.2.3, ownMoveRefusal listSubmitted) are a separate story.

US-07.1.1 is a clean match, and its only visible blemish is the stale confirm copy, which is fixed under US-07.2.1.

US-07.2.2 and the snapshot part of US-07.3.1 depend on other epics. They need the flat Contract model and step rail (EP-04: US-04.3.5 snapshot, US-04.3.8 invoice destination, US-04.3.11 move-fit), a typed price on a non-open-price Contract and 'Needs a price' (EP-05, US-05.2.8), the payer on the Booking, insurer and approval number, and the under-18 warning (EP-11: US-11.2.2, 11.2.4, 11.4.3), and the flagged-for-office marker (EP-03, US-03.6.3). Rebuild the Review screen after those fields exist; the Route column and the ACC-on-patient and 'Not marked completed' flags in reviewFlags.ts are the old reading. OQ-135 (Disabled Contract flag) is open, so leave it unbuilt until answered.

Demo script: S2 Beat 4 (authorise Morrison from the Review queue) and S3 Beat 1 (authorise Forte AM and St George's PM) use the current Review screen and 'Authorise for billing', so they survive, but the table columns, flags and the 'locked on submit / no return' talking points change. S1 and S2 lines saying the anaesthetist cannot edit after submit would change. The S4 contract-failure beat (retry un-end-dates the live Contract) would sit awkwardly beside a snapshot-at-lock rule.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations: All three gradings upheld after re-opening the code. Shared structural gaps: the Invoice/ACCREC/ACCPAY model has no credit-note kind, no reversal link between invoices, no negative payable netted by the payables run, and the ACCPAY payee is always an anaesthetist (no AA Holding payee, shared with US-06.5.1 and the US-06.3.1 prepayment flow). The Xero simulator would gain a clearing-account view that nets to zero (accountant meeting, 10 Nov: 'an instant flag'). A PERSIST_VERSION bump is needed for any seed or shape change. Dependencies: US-09.1.1 and US-09.1.4 (Xero pair and agency fields), US-10.2.5 (netting and remittance), US-08.6.3 and US-08.6.5 (OQ-97), US-13.5.2 (audit), OQ-29 (still open). Demo-script impact: the S3 invoice and Xero pair beats and any prepayment beat that shows a paid prepayment disbursed to the anaesthetist would change, since a paid prepayment would be held until the procedure is done; the S3 agency-line caption changes if the invoice is re-presented in the anaesthetist's name with a GST number; a credit-and-rebill beat would be new.

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations: EP-09 items graded here are small. The one real gap is US-09.1.1's prepayment parenthetical, and it is the same gap as the Agreed US-09.1.3: the prototype has no AA Holding account, so a prepayment pair's ACCPAY pays the anaesthetist and is disbursed to them on receipt, with no settlement second pair on List authorisation. It should be closed once, with the EP-06 holding-account work (US-06.5.1, FT-06.3, FT-06.4, US-09.1.3): a Holding payee contact in place of anaesthetistContactSpec for prepayment cases in handoffCase, plus a settlement pair. Code comments in listMoveActions.ts and slotActions.ts already assume the holding account exists, so they run ahead of the code. Minor extra: the ACCPAY InvoiceNumber carries a '-P' suffix, where the story wording says each invoice carries the engine's number. US-09.1.4 depends on OQ-29 and US-08.4.5; it is S-sized (BCTI label and details on the ACCPAY card) once the accountant answers, and the per-procedure vs per-payment vs per-run grouping would feed bcti.ts and FT-10.3. US-09.4.1 matches; an optional one-line 'separate org, not the general ledger, trust money' callout in DemoXero would make it explicit. Demo script S3 (Beats 2 and 3) and S4/S5 pair views would change only if the prepayment pair moves to a holding account.

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations:
Structural: the main EP-10 issue is that the prototype treats paying the anaesthetist as an in-system action (admin 'Run payables', Xero-sim 'Pay now', actor 'Payables run'). FT-10.2, US-09.2.4 and OQ-111 (answered 4 Nov) say Xero's payables run makes the payment and the engine detects and records it. The fix is to move the payout into the Xero simulator as a badged demo action, add webhook and poll detection of an ACCPAY payment, and turn the Admin monitor card into read-only tracking. The disbursement actions (runPayables, disbursePayable) have exactly two callers (BillingMonitorScreen, DemoXero), so the change is contained. Closely tied to US-09.2.4 in EP-09.

Dependencies: US-10.2.7 (weekly payment cycle, Proposed, OQ-47 open; Greg now proposes Monday to Sunday week, Thursday payment) is not built (no ISO week, close or reconciliation step) and sits outside this item list; US-10.2.6 and the 'next payables run' wording of US-10.2.1 depend on it. Whether BCTI approval equals release is part of OQ-47. BCTI count and period (OQ-29, one per payment or per weekly run) would change the per-procedure ACCPAY model US-10.2.6 relies on. Prepayments and the AA Holding account are not modelled in UI at all (only comments), so prepaid money can currently be disbursed like any other; that belongs to the EP-06/08 prepayment work but bears on the one-path story. AA fee never netted (US-10.3) is unaffected.

Demo-script impact: S3 Beat 3 (03-demo-script.md ~519-531) and S4 part-payment steps (~652-655: Run payables, Payment received full, Run payables again), 02-workflows Workflow 7 step 6, and 01-personas 'Run disbursements' use the in-app Run payables button; re-homing to a Xero simulator action changes those beats. A bulk-remittance tab (US-10.2.4) is additive to the Xero sim only. US-10.2.1 and US-10.1.1 need no code change. Any seed-shape change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 26).

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: Structural: the prototype's money model is route-first per Procedure (billingRoute hospital/billableParty/insurer, a BillableParty master, an Insurer master with acceptsDirectClaims, and contract holders of type hospital/insurer/surgeon/organisation/billableParty that bill the holder). EP-11 now assumes the flat Contract model: each Contract carries a 'bills its holder or the payer' setting, holders and insurers/funders are shared Parties (EP-04), and the Booking holds the payer (prefilled from the patient, with email or postal address), the insurer/funder and an approval number. FT-11.2, US-11.2.1, US-11.2.2 and US-11.4.3 therefore depend on the EP-04 contract rework (Party entity, bills-holder setting, No contract RVG and Fixed price fallbacks); the insurer acceptsDirectClaims master, setInsurerDirectClaims and direct-claim validation should be retired, and the Doyle bariatric surgeon-held Type 3 contract must bill the payer. Other dependencies: US-11.1.1 depends on US-11.1.4 and US-02.6.1 (NHI-less bookings wait as stubs; remove provisional patient creation in intake.ts, the PT0010 Noah Prescott seed and the provisionalNoNhi scenario). US-11.2.3 (payer email or postal address, NZ Post format; OQ-122 posted invoices) and US-11.2.4 are wholly absent. US-11.2.4, US-11.3.2 and US-11.4.3 depend on the warnings framework (US-13.7.1 and 13.7.2: one rule today, prepaymentUnpaid) and the dashboard to-do. US-11.3.2 and FT-11.3 also need a patient-level balance view in Admin (no Patients master/screen; only the Billing monitor 'Prior balance' pill), invoice-date aging against a fixed 90-day threshold, and a credit-balance concept (receivePayment clamps to balance). Anaesthetist-facing parts (payer edit, approval number, balance alert colour code) are absent on mobile and web: OfficeBillingSetup is office-only. Demo beats affected: S3 (Mitchell prior balance, nib insurer invoice, guardian Hana Park/Grace Park), S4 (prepayment, COS ACC billing failure, insuredReimbursement AIA) and S1 (NHI dedupe, NHI-less Noah Prescott). New beats needed for the booking-time balance alert and the under-18 payer warning. All ten reviewer gradings were upheld after re-checking the code; no verdict changes."

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations: EP-12 slice here is FT-12.2 plus US-12.2.1. FT-12.2's own body states rules (flat list; monthly GST report of payments AA passed on; ledger not Xero), so it is graded normally, not Grouping. The ageing concept lives in three places that must change together: web Accounts 'Overdue' sub-tab and route (/web/accounts/overdue), the web Dashboard 'Receivables aging' panel with its onViewOverdue link (the dashboard is US-12.2.3 and links to US-08.3.5 'financial position'; check whether that story wants ageing at all before removing the panel), and the mobile AgeChip. Add bookingId and listId to AccpayInvoiceRow so both apps can link to the Booking. The GST report (sibling US-12.2.2, status Verify, graded elsewhere) should switch from billing.receipts to disbursements (billing.disbursements has atISO) and drop the period selector and the masters gstPeriod read (retired in US-12.1.2), and add a download/print action on web (US-03.1.4). The ledger-not-Xero rule already holds: all these views read state.billing. OQ-123 (billing-practice reporting hooks) and OQ-134 (overdue alerts vs prepayment alert, which affects US-06.3.2 and US-11.3.2, not this list) are unresolved and do not change either grade; OQ-123 can be a presenter talking point. Demo guide: S3 Beat 3 narrates 'does not remain under Overdue', Beat 4 mentions 'Payables, GST activity and Overdue', docs/demo-guide/01-personas mentions receivables ageing, and 04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md around line 372 says 'aging is derived'; these need rewording. S1, S2, S4 and S5 are unaffected.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: US-13.2.4 is purely additive and has no home in the current code. The Admin app does have a Day dashboard (Day grid, DraftListBand, WarningsToDo list for warnings, US-13.7.2), so a reconciliation box and an unresolved-items list can sit there and reuse the to-do pattern, with no new page. The real work is a small posting model: clearing accounts, sub-ledger and control accounts, and Xero bank lines with an unplaced-receipt state. That model should be built once and shared with US-13.2.1 (ledger) and US-10.2.4 (bulk remittance, where an unplaceable receipt is parked); the catch-up plan's phase 36 ledger work is the natural place. The Xero simulator (apps/demo/DemoXero.tsx) needs a bank-line list. A PERSIST_VERSION bump is needed if the seed shape changes, and the demo guide should gain a square / not-square beat. S1 to S5 beats are unlikely to break.

epics.title: Health systems integration
epics.observations: EP-14 is mostly a parent of FT-14.1 to FT-14.6 (Future Work lane), but its body states three rules of its own: the first-release sync of both integrated hospitals into the matching screen, the NHI lookup being in scope, and the adapter and configuration-matrix design. The prototype's HL7/FHIR pipeline is already badged Future scope (catch-up Phase 14, to be demoted in Phase 34), so the Future-lane message is in place. The real gap is structural and sits in EP-02: there is no hospital download or matching screen (FT-02.1, US-02.1.5, Phase 33). Until then, integrationActions applyEffect writes hospital messages directly as Bookings onto Dr Souter's existing ACTIVE List. The first-release sync depends on that screen being built and on those messages being rerouted into it, which is also where the OQ-118 stub-at-intake question interacts. epics.observations: EP-15 is mostly cross-cutting and infrastructure; only US-15.0.8 is real new prototype work. (1) US-15.0.8 needs a new Help/Support panel in the Admin app (office staff are the audience): phone and email lines, a single configurable support-hours string (OQ-137 also affects US-02.5.4, so keep it one constant), and optionally a mock ticket list with a demo 'advance ticket' control. (2) US-15.0.7 already holds because everything reads one reactive persisted store; the refresh mechanism is unagreed with AA, so no build is needed now; an optional PWA-only 'Office changes this Booking's time' chip would help show it on a phone (relates to US-15.0.3). (4) The ~28,000 invoices/year figure is only a narrated counter (settings.volumeStory, shown in Admin Reference views and Demo Xero); a real volume demo would need a larger seed, a PERSIST_VERSION bump and care over the localStorage budget, and is optional. items.summary: Owner-only submit and the office's Booking move work, but a prepaid Booking's payable goes to the anaesthetist on the List, not an AA Holding account, so a move leaves it with the wrong person; the anaesthetist-led move to a new List does not exist (status Verify).
items.requirement_says: Whoever submits a List did all its procedures; a Booking done by another anaesthetist is moved to that anaesthetist's List (even a single-Booking List). Unprepaid: payable follows the Booking to the doer. Prepaid: payable is the AA Holding account and does not move, the doer is paid from it at settlement; nothing is recalculated or re-triggered on the move.
items.prototype_does: submitList is owner-only and needs every non-cancelled Booking completed; anaesthetists cannot edit another's List. The office can move one Booking to any non-AUTHORISED List (MoveBookingFlow to reassignBooking), which touches no prepayment or invoice. The Xero handoff derives the ACCPAY payee from the Booking's List's anaesthetist at handoff time, so an unprepaid Booking moved before handoff is paid to the new anaesthetist. A prepayment invoice also hands off at once with a payable to the List's anaesthetist (raisePreProcedureInvoice then handoffCasesForBooking); there is no AA Holding creditor and no settlement transfer, and an already-created accPay keeps its anaesthetistId after a move (code comments mark a 'Phase 41 seam').
missing_or_wrong: No AA Holding payable: a prepaid Booking's ACCPAY is created for the anaesthetist on the List at handoff and never repointed, so after a move A stays the payee and B, who did the work, is not paid from it (contradicts AC 3 and AC 4). The prepayment itself is still the old deposit/self-funded model rather than the Contract-flagged full-amount prepayment of EP-06.
An already-handed-off unprepaid ACCPAY is not repointed when the Booking later moves (payee fixed at handoff).

An anaesthetist cannot move a Booking to a colleague as a new List: reassignBooking refuses anaesthetists unless both Lists are their own (notOwnList), the older reading. Only the office path produces 'Booking ends up on B's List' (see US-01.4.7).

items.summary: Change types exist as HL7 event handling and are audited with source, but changes apply automatically without pre-apply classification or office approval, and a day move is a reassign rather than cancel plus new Booking. Feature Agreed; OQ-124 open.

A day move arrives as a cancellation plus a new Booking. Each change is recorded with its source and history. Applying automatically is Future Work; in release 1 the office reviews and approves.
items.prototype_does: Classification is implicit in the canned event type (S12 new, S13 reschedule, S14 modify, S15 cancel); each lands in audited store actions (booking.create, booking.edit, booking.cancel, booking.reassign) as actor source 'integration', visible in the Booking history and the Audit viewer. All apply immediately. S13 to another day calls reassignBooking (one move).

No UI states the classification (New, Modification, Cancellation)
No 'what changed' comparison between versions of a List (OQ-124)

items.verify_note: Status Agreed so re-checked fully: applyEffect applies without any approval, and S13 cross-List uses reassignBooking. Contradicts (implemented behaviour is wrong), not Partial.

The admin Audit viewer is a read-only feed with entity, source and date filters (apps/admin/screens/AuditViewer.tsx:43-95), and each Booking has a History sheet.

The replaced-procedure-text entry belongs to US-02.5.7, not here.

The S12 hospital create is an interim stand-in for the hospital download (store/integrationActions.ts:169-171). The text appears as a heading on the capture block (shared/capture/BtmCaptureBlock.tsx:134) and on Booking detail (BookingDetailBody.tsx:594), not alongside a Contract and RVG choice as US-03.1.9 describes.

It is used by the Admin Booking detail. Feed changes carry the feed's actor label (store/integrationActions.ts:46-48) with source 'integration', so the hospital system is named. Corrected surfaces (stubs must also show to the anaesthetist on web/mobile List views) and size M to L: needs a new stub entity, rendering on every List surface, refusing a no-NHI Booking per US-11.1.4, and rework of seed and the PDF pathway. items.requirement_says: Four states; ACTIVE when five-part pairing complete; submit sends to office but the anaesthetist can still see it and anyone can change it until authorised (last change stands); authorising locks Bookings, Procedures and selected Contracts and hands the whole List to billing.
items.prototype_does: ListState DRAFT|ACTIVE|SUBMITTED|AUTHORISED with ordered guards; submitList completion-gated; authoriseList office-only, emits listAuthorised, billing run bills the whole List. editRefusal refuses the anaesthetist on any non-ACTIVE List ('Only the office can change it now'); submit sheet says they cannot change the bookings afterwards. No Contract version is locked.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: anaesthetist cannot edit a SUBMITTED List (store/lifecycle.ts editRefusal ~:72); catalogue says anyone can until authorised, last change stands
WRONG: submit confirmation copy 'not be able to change these bookings afterwards' (SubmitListSheet.tsx:110)
MISSING: authorisation does not lock selected Contract versions (no Contract versioning; see US-07.3.1)
MISSING: submitted List not shown less prominently to the anaesthetist

items.title: List approval workflow

items.summary: ACTIVE is the five-part-paired state, reached by office assignment of a Draft List or set up with its anaesthetist (recurring booking), and reverting to Draft on move/withdraw/unavailable return.
items.requirement_says: A List is ACTIVE once it has anaesthetist, surgeon, hospital, day and session; reached by assigning a Draft List or being set up with its anaesthetist (e.g. recurring booking); anaesthetist completes Bookings then submits.
items.prototype_does: isActivePairing encodes the five-part rule (store-wide invariant test); assignDraftList flips DRAFT to ACTIVE; own move/withdraw/unavailable return detaches to DRAFT with anaesthetistId/slotId cleared; recurring bookings place Lists with anaesthetist (ACTIVE); Draft Lists refuse edit/complete/submit/authorise ('Assign an anaesthetist first').
items.verify_note: Checked each reach/revert path in code (assign, recurring placement, own move to office, unavailable return) and that DRAFT Lists are refused lifecycle actions. No acceptance criteria on this item; nothing contradicting found. Confidence raised to high.
items.title: ACTIVE

items.summary: Office review queue and SUBMITTED state exist, but the anaesthetist cannot change a submitted List and it is not shown less prominently.
items.requirement_says: After submit the office reviews and corrects; the anaesthetist can still see it and change it until authorised; submit makes it less prominent for the anaesthetist and tells the office it has work.
items.prototype_does: Admin Review queue lists SUBMITTED Lists with sidebar badge and count; office can edit SUBMITTED. Anaesthetist can view the List ('Submitted to office' footer) but all edit is blocked; mobile shows it under Done / same row style, no reduced prominence.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: anaesthetist edit blocked on SUBMITTED
MISSING: Submitted List not shown less prominent to the anaesthetist (normal row, or under Done tab)

items.title: SUBMITTED

items.summary: Authorising locks the List and hands it to the billing run as one unit; every Booking/Procedure write is refused afterwards.
items.requirement_says: Once authorised a List is locked and handed to the Billing/Invoice Engine as a single unit so the engine works from a stable record.
items.prototype_does: authoriseList emits listAuthorised; wireBillingRun runs runBillingForList for the whole List in one commit then hands cases to Xero; editRefusal blocks all edits on AUTHORISED; moves and time changes on AUTHORISED Lists are refused too. Contract-version locking is a US-07.3.1/US-04.3.5 matter, not stated in this feature body.
items.verify_note: Feature body states only lock + single-unit handoff; both verified in code (event wiring, synchronous run, guards on moves/time edits). Contract-version lock is asserted by EP-07 and US-07.3.1, graded there.

When all are complete, a teal submit opens a confirm sheet, then the success overlay and a 'Submitted to office' state. Audited as list.submit.
evidence: aa-prototype/src/shared/flows/SubmitListSheet.tsx:34-90 (blockers mode lists each incomplete Booking and its failures)

items.title: Submit a List

items.summary: The prototype locks a List to the anaesthetist the moment it is SUBMITTED (store refusal, hidden edit controls, copy); the requirement now says they can keep changing Bookings until the office authorises.
items.requirement_says: After submit the anaesthetist still sees the List and can change its Bookings until the office authorises it; changes are audited and the office sees them at review (last change stands). It stays visible, less prominent, scrolling up from today on the main view, until authorised. Once AUTHORISED the anaesthetist cannot change it.
items.prototype_does: editRefusal refuses an anaesthetist on any non-ACTIVE List with 'This List has been submitted. Only the office can change it now.' items.title: Anaesthetist can still edit a submitted List

items.summary: Admin has a Review screen, but it is built on the old three-route model (Route column, first-procedure-only Contract, ACC-on-patient flag) and lacks payer, insurer and approval number, flagged-for-office, Contract and price flags, and the under-18 warning.
items.requirement_says: Per Booking on a submitted List the admin approves or corrects each Procedure's Contract, seeing text as received, Contract and RVG code, insurer and approval number, the payer named on the Booking (changeable), references and invoice emails, Procedures the anaesthetist flagged for the office, review flags (Contract changed by the anaesthetist; typed price on a non-open-price Contract beside the computed price; Contract no longer fits after a move), 'Needs an invoice destination' and 'Needs a price', and a non-blocking warning when a child under 18 is the payer. The insurer never narrows the choice and the Contract decides who is billed.
items.prototype_does: ReviewScreen lists non-cancelled Bookings in a table (Time, Patient, Route, Contract, Code, Times, B-T-M, Units, Fee, Flags). Route is Hospital/Patient/Insurer/Mixed/Not set. Contract name and RVG code are those of the first Procedure only. Flags come from reviewFlags.ts: 'Not marked completed', 'No billing reference' (hospital route), 'ACC should not bill the patient directly', and manual B/T/M override. A warning triangle shows the unpaid-prepayment warning, plus History and phone notes. The office corrects billing setup on Booking detail (OfficeBillingSetup: route, insurer, category, governing contract, reference, guardian payer, price override). Authorise is never blocked by flags.
missing_or_wrong: Route-based billing model (billingRoute hospital/billableParty/insurer) conflicts with the flat Contract model where the selected Contract decides the payer and the insurer only suggests a path on the step rail
Review shows only the first Procedure's Contract and code, not each Procedure, and not text as received, then Contract, then RVG code
No insurer or insurance approval number on the Booking or in review (no approval field in domain types); no 'insured Booking with no approval number' warning (US-11.4.3)
Payer is a per-Procedure billablePartyId guardian override, not 'the payer named on the Booking' shown in review with default patient; no change-payer control in the review itself
No 'flagged for the office to check' Procedure marker (US-03.6.3) and none surfaced at review
Missing review flags: Contract changed by the anaesthetist; typed price on a non-open-price Contract beside the computed price; Contract no longer fits after a List move
No 'Needs an invoice destination' (step rail) or 'Needs a price' states
No under-18 payer warning (US-11.2.4); invoice email addresses and addresses are not reviewed
Old flags 'ACC should not bill the patient directly' and 'Not marked completed' are prototype-era readings not in the story and are implemented behaviour that differs from it
No Contract approve-or-correct action in the Review table itself (correction is only via Booking detail OfficeBillingSetup)
OQ-135 (flag for a Disabled Contract) is unresolved; it is not built and there is nothing to contradict, so it is not a gap yet
evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/screens/ReviewScreen.tsx:60-100 (rows: routeText, primary only), :244-282 (table columns, Route and Contract cells)
aa-prototype/src/domain/types.ts:780-870 (BillingRoute, governingContractId, insurerId, billablePartyId, billingReference; no approval number)

searched: approvalNumber|approval number|insuranceApproval|flaggedFor|flagForOffice|Needs an invoice|Needs a price|under 18|under-18|snapshot in src -> no hits relevant (only unrelated 'children'/'snapshot' comments)

Contradicts holds: the Route column and the ACC-on-patient flag are implemented behaviour from the old three-route reading that the Contract model decisions replaced. I added the missing Contract approve-or-correct action in review, invoice emails, and the per-Procedure scope gap. Size L is right (domain fields, review rebuild, seed), depending on EP-04, EP-05 and EP-11 data. Confidence is medium because the story is Verify (3).
items.title: Office review of Contracts and references

items.summary: Office corrects Bookings directly with no Returned state (as required), but the clause that the anaesthetist can also still change it, last change standing, is contradicted by the edit block.
items.requirement_says: Admin corrects a Booking directly without sending it back; no 'returned' state; until authorised the anaesthetist can also change it and the last change stands.
items.prototype_does: Office edits SUBMITTED Bookings in Day view booking detail (edit, cancel, billing setup, price override) with audit; no return transition (logListNote only annotates; no Returned state anywhere). Anaesthetist edits on SUBMITTED are refused, so 'neither side has authority' cannot occur.

items.title: Office corrections

items.summary: Authorise, lock, whole-List handoff to billing and no partial release all work; the copy of the selected Contracts into each Procedure's pricing snapshot at authorisation does not exist.
items.requirement_says: The admin marks a submitted List AUTHORISED, locking its Bookings, Procedures and the Contracts selected for them (copied into each Procedure's pricing snapshot), and passes the whole List to the Billing/Invoice Engine as one unit. There is no partial release, and a failing Booking is held for a manual fix while the rest invoices.
items.prototype_does: authoriseList (office only, SUBMITTED only) sets AUTHORISED, audits list.authorise and emits listAuthorised. editRefusal then locks every Booking edit for all actors. The billing run invoices the whole List at once, with per-Booking failure held as a BillingCase while the others invoice, and the Billing monitor offers Resolve and retry. The Admin Review screen has a confirm overlay, an 'Authorised · locked' banner, lock icons and an 'N invoices raised' line. There is no return to the anaesthetist and no partial release.
missing_or_wrong: No pricing snapshot is copied into each Procedure at authorisation: authoriseList only flips state, and the billing run reads live Contracts and rates at run time (the Billing monitor retry even un-end-dates the live Contract and re-rates), so 'invoice stays tied to what was true at lock' is not demonstrated
Confirm text and review do not mention the Contract snapshot, and no snapshot is visible on an authorised Procedure
evidence: searched: pricingSnapshot|snapshot in src -> no per-Procedure Contract snapshot
items.demo_trigger: Existing: 'Authorise for billing' on the Review screen already shows the lock and whole-List handoff. For the snapshot, add a read-only 'Pricing snapshot (locked at authorisation)' panel per Procedure on an authorised Booking, and a Master data Contract-edit demo showing the authorised Booking's price does not change.
items.verify_note: Re-read authoriseList, editRefusal and the billing run, and grepped for snapshot. Nothing is copied into a Procedure at lock, so Partial stands and nothing implemented contradicts the rule (it is missing, not wrong). The lock, single-unit handoff, no partial release and held-Booking behaviour all hold. Size M depends on US-04.3.5 for the Contract data shape.
items.title: Authorise the List

items.prototype_does: editRefusal returns listAuthorised for all actors including integration, used by booking, procedure, billing-line, attachment and intake writes; List move and time change also refuse AUTHORISED; UI hides edit controls; Demo Data guard tester can attempt editBooking/authoriseList; post-op addendum creates a NEW linked Booking on a new List.

items.verify_note: Searched for write paths that bypass editRefusal (move, detach-to-draft, time edit, post-op addendum): all refuse or create new records. No contradicting behaviour found.

items.summary: The engine builds, sends and mirrors invoices, but it nets prepaid amounts as a visible negative line instead of leaving prepaid Procedures off (wrong), and there is no internal ledger as system of record (missing).
items.requirement_says: On AUTHORISED the engine reads each locked Procedure and Contract, applies multi-procedure rules, leaves prepaid Procedures off the final invoice, creates linked receivable and payable records in its own ledger, sends invoices and mirrors them to Xero. The internal ledger, not Xero, is the system of record. Delivery constraint: a one-month parallel run with variance reconciliation.
items.prototype_does: wireBillingRun builds invoices per Booking on AUTHORISED, ranks across all Procedures for multi-procedure pricing, emails an invoice document and hands off to a Xero ACCREC plus draft ACCPAY pair. A prepaid Procedure still gets its fee lines plus a 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' negative line. The receivable/payable pair exists only in the Xero simulation slice; no ledger exists.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: prepaid Procedures are netted by a 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line, not left off (see US-08.2.2)
No internal ledger as system of record: the pair is state.xero.accRecs/accPays and nothing survives independently of Xero
No AA Holding account creditor and no journal transfer on authorisation for prepaid Bookings
Ledger balance views (whole ledger, per anaesthetist, per patient) from the domain model are absent
Parallel-run reconciliation (legacy vs new variance report) is not represented
evidence: searched: ledger|holding in src -> only HistoryTimeline change-ledger UI and unrelated comments

Optional parallel-run reconciliation view with a 'Load legacy totals' demo button on Admin Billing Monitor showing variance by anaesthetist, hospital and contract.

items.requirement_says: Every procedure invoice creates a linked receivable (billable party) and payable (anaesthetist) pair in the engine's own ledger. A prepayment invoice's payable is to the AA Holding account, with a second pair moving it to the anaesthetist at settlement. The monthly AA fee invoice has no payable. The ledger tracks per patient and per anaesthetist and keeps history independent of Xero contact changes.

Prepayment invoices go through the same handoff (prepaymentActions calls handoffCasesForBooking), so the payable is to the List's anaesthetist and is authorised as payments arrive. AA fee invoices are ACCRECs of kind aaFee with no ACCPAY (matches). Patient contacts are pseudonymised and archive in Xero.

WRONG: prepayment payable is to the anaesthetist (xeroHandoff resolves the List's anaesthetist), not the AA Holding account

WRONG: a prepayment's payable is released as payments arrive, so money can reach the anaesthetist before the procedure is done
No per patient or per anaesthetist ledger tracking or view; history is not independent of Xero contact archiving
evidence: searched: holding|AA Holding|ledger in src -> none

items.summary: The only late-charge path is the old post-op addendum (a separate Booking on a new List, priced by Contract/RVG), which contradicts the now-written model of events on the Procedure and free-form additional invoices; credit/rebill and next-run bundling are also absent.
items.requirement_says: Late charges and corrections are handled without unlocking the immutable Booking: late charges are additional invoices or post-op events (both events on the Procedure, standard review, billed in the next run, bundled per billable party where possible); a wrong invoice is credited in full then rebilled; a post-invoice split uses the credit note option then new additional invoices.
items.prototype_does: An 'Add post-op event' button on an AUTHORISED Booking calls addPostOpAddendum, which creates a separate postOpAddendum Booking on a new List in today's free session of the original anaesthetist; the original stays locked. The addendum then goes through its own List submit, authorise and billing-run cycle, priced from Contract/RVG. No additional invoice, credit note, credit-and-rebill, event element or per-billable-party bundling. Invoice.kind is only 'standard'|'prePayment'. Code comments mark the addendum as interim.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: late charge is modelled as a separate Booking on a new List needing a free session, not an event on the Procedure; it is priced by Contract/RVG, not free-form.
WRONG: the addendum goes through the List submit/authorise cycle, not the standard event review step, and is not billed in the next run as an event.
Additional invoice (free-form, attached to the original Procedure) does not exist (see US-08.6.3).
Credit in full then rebill does not exist (no credit note, no payable reversal, no negative invoice netted in a payment run; see US-08.6.2).
Credit note option for splits does not exist (see US-08.6.5).
No rule that every event marked for invoicing is billed in the next run on the same invoice as other lines for the same billable party (OQ-121).

items.requirement_says: When a List is AUTHORISED the engine processes each Booking and Procedure, reading the Contract already locked to that Procedure. It works out no route or payer of its own: price, rules and billable party come from the locked Contract, plus the Booking's payer where the Contract bills the payer.

items.summary: The prototype prices a prepaid Procedure at its final fee and nets the prepayment off the final invoice as a visible 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line; the story says prepaid Procedures are left off entirely, with no deduction and no automatic difference billing.
items.requirement_says: The engine leaves every prepaid Procedure off the final invoice: no prepayment line, no deduction. A mixed Booking's final invoice carries only the not-prepaid Procedures; an all-prepaid Booking has no final invoice; a prepaid primary does not change the multi-procedure price of the others. The prepaid Procedure's price is the prepaid amount, with no automatic difference invoice or credit.
items.prototype_does: runBillingForList passes prePaidByProcedure into buildInvoicesForBooking, which still rates the prepaid Procedure at its final fee and adds a negative 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line on its counterparty group. A full prepayment nets to zero and the group is dropped (accidentally giving 'no invoice'), a split prepayment bills the balance, a final fee above the deposit is billed automatically, and one below fails with a negativeTotal exception. Exceptions prepaidFunderOverride and prepaidCounterpartyChanged exist. Split deposits (prepaymentDetail split + depositAmount) are modelled and seeded.

The patient sees a prepayment deduction line on the final invoice, which the story forbids
Split deposits exist but prepayments are now all or nothing
The difference between prepaid amount and final fee is billed (or fails negativeTotal) instead of never being invoiced or credited automatically

Mixed Booking and prepaid-primary multi-procedure pricing are not guaranteed: the additional-procedure price is calculated on the whole Booking but the prepaid one is still on the invoice
Anaesthetist payment from the AA Holding account transfer (US-06.5.1) is not represented
Exceptions prepaidFunderOverride and prepaidCounterpartyChanged are old-model concepts

items.summary: A procedure invoice gets a linked ACCREC and draft ACCPAY pair created together, but a prepayment invoice's payable goes to the anaesthetist (not the AA Holding account) and there is no clearing account or out-of-step indicator.
items.requirement_says: Every procedure invoice yields a receivable from the billable party and a matching payable to the anaesthetist, linked to each other and to the Booking/Procedures; for a prepayment invoice the payable is to the AA Holding account until the procedure is done. Neither side can be created, paid or reversed without the other; Xero posts the pair through a clearing account that should net to zero.
items.prototype_does: handoffCase creates the ACCREC and a draft ACCPAY in one mutate (idempotent; a failed handoff leaves no pair), with the case/booking links held on the BillingCase and invoice. The ACCPAY payee is always the List's anaesthetist and amountPayable = invoice.total, with no prepayment branch, so a prepayment invoice follows the same handoff. receivePayment authorises the ACCPAY up to the amount received (payableReleasedFor) and a payables run disburses it, so prepayment money reaches the anaesthetist as soon as it is paid. The Xero simulator shows the pair and its links. There is no Holding account, no clearing account, and no reversal path.
missing_or_wrong: Prepayment invoice's payable goes to the anaesthetist and is released on payment; it should be to the AA Holding account (US-06.5.1) until the procedure is done (contradiction)
No Holding account (a creditor in the payables sub-ledger) and no transfer to the anaesthetist on completion
No clearing account in the simulated Xero posting and no zero-balance 'pair out of step' indicator
'Reversed together' is not representable: no reversal of either side exists (see US-08.6.2)
ACCPAY itself carries only accRecId and the case reference; the Booking/Procedure link is via the BillingCase and invoice lines (minor)

Triggers 'Payment received full/half' and 'Replay last payment event' exist. Fetch/check steps are implicit in the call.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Demo actions > Payment received full / half / Replay last payment event (Admin invoice page and /demo/xero/invoices/:id).
items.verify_note: Checked exact-amount rule (cumulative min, not proportional) and idempotency; no acceptance criteria beyond body. Prepayment interaction is handled under US-09.1.3.

items.summary: Webhook and poll share one handler and a replayed event has no further effect. The dedupe key is a per-payment idempotency key rather than InvoiceID, which behaves correctly for partial payments.
items.requirement_says: Webhook path and daily poll write through the same handler keyed by Xero InvoiceID, so duplicates or poll re-detection have no further effect.
items.prototype_does: receivePayment serves both paths; a receipt with the same idempotencyKey returns applied:false. 'Replay last event' shows 'Duplicate webhook ignored'. The poll skips payments whose key is already mirrored (webhook-created PaymentIn shares the key).

items.summary: The prototype records disbursement, but as an AA office action (Admin 'Run payables', and a Xero-simulator button that calls the same office function), not as the engine detecting an ACCPAY paid in Xero's payables run via webhook or poll; this is the older reading that OQ-111 (answered 4 Nov, not yet seen by Greg) now reverses. Story is Verify, so graded against the text as written.
items.requirement_says: Xero makes the payment to the anaesthetist in its payables run; the engine learns of it by webhook or the daily poll and records the disbursement against the ledger payable, so paid-into-AA and disbursed-to-anaesthetist stay two separately tracked states. The system tracks payments, it does not make them.
items.prototype_does: Both paths call the system's own disbursement writer. (1) Admin Billing monitor 'Run payables' card (unbadged product UI, office-only): copy says 'N payables authorised, $X to disburse to anaesthetists'; pays amountAuthorised minus amountDisbursed on every ACCPAY, writing Disbursement rows with a payablesRunId, accPay.amountDisbursed/status paid, and BillingCase disbursedAmount/status 'disbursed' (audited xero.disbursed, actor 'Payables run'). (2) The Xero simulator pair-detail button 'Simulate payment and payout' / 'Pay <anaesthetist> now' applies the customer payment via receivePayment (source webhook), then calls disbursePayable with OFFICE_ACTOR, so the Xero-side payout is just the office function. The two-state split itself exists (receivedAmount vs disbursedAmount; chips in InvoiceDocument, Billing monitor, Web accounts). Webhook and poll machinery exists only for ACCREC payments; there is no ACCPAY-paid event, no Xero-side 'paid' state separate from the engine's record, and the daily poll does not detect payable payments.
missing_or_wrong: WRONG: Admin 'Run payables' button and card copy make the system perform the disbursement ('to disburse to anaesthetists'), contradicting OQ-111 (Xero pays, system only tracks)
WRONG: disbursement is written by an office-role action (disbursePayable/runPayables refuse non-office actors) rather than by an engine detection handler fed by Xero
MISSING: no ACCPAY payment detection by webhook (a receipt-like handler for a paid ACCPAY with idempotency key and source webhook|poll)
MISSING: the reconciliation poll (runReconciliationPoll) only re-detects ACCREC PaymentIn records; it does not catch a missed ACCPAY payment

MISSING: Xero simulator has no 'Pay in payables run' action that marks the ACCPAY paid in Xero itself, separate from the engine's amountDisbursed; Xero and engine share one XeroAccPay record so 'detected' is not distinguishable from 'made'
MISSING: no visible state where Xero has paid but the engine has not yet recorded it (e.g. missed webhook) and no way to show the poll catching it
Wording: DemoControlPanel line 504 and demo-guide beat S4/exceptions step 5 describe 'Run payables' as product UI that pays the amount received

items.title: Two payment states

items.summary: A payment authorises the matching ACCPAY for exactly the cumulative amount received; a part payment releases only that amount with the remainder outstanding on the receivable; authorised payables are what the (in-system) run picks up. OQ-47 (weekly cycle, BCTI approval) is open but does not change this story's rule.
items.requirement_says: When a receivable is paid, the matching payable is authorised so it enters the next payables run. Paid in full releases the whole payable; a part payment releases a payable for exactly the amount received and the remainder stays outstanding on the receivable.
items.prototype_does: receivePayment clamps to the balance, bumps ACCREC amountReceived and status, and sets ACCPAY amountAuthorised to payableReleasedFor(newReceived, payable) (min of cumulative received and payable), flipping DRAFT to AUTHORISED on first release; a second payment lifts the cumulative figure. Idempotent by key (webhook or poll). payablesDue counts authorised minus disbursed; the Billing monitor says 'A payable authorises for exactly what its ACCREC has received'. Demo triggers 'Payment received full/half/replay' on invoice and Xero pair pages cover it, and the S4 script proves it with two runs across a part-then-balance payment.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Demo actions > 'Payment received · full' and 'Payment received · half' on /admin/invoices/:invoiceId and /demo/xero/invoices/:accRecId.

The story links to the weekly 'payables run' (US-10.2.7), which is unbuilt, and the run itself is made in-system (the FT-10.2 contradiction); both are graded under FT-10.2 and US-10.2.7, not here, because this story's rule is only the authorisation. Kept Matches.
items.title: Payable released to match the amount received

items.summary: Every receipt (webhook or poll) is reconciled to its billing case/invoice and displayed against the invoice; poll catches missed webhooks.
items.requirement_says: Every receipt recorded in Xero is reconciled back to the ledger record it belongs to, keeping the internal ledger (system of record) in step with Xero.
items.prototype_does: receivePayment (shared by webhook and poll, idempotent by key) writes PaymentIn, updates ACCREC, BillingCase and a BillingReceipt keyed to case/ACCREC; runReconciliationPoll on dayAdvanced re-detects unmirrored Xero payments and applies them via the same handler with the original receipt date. Web Payments shows receipt against invoice number; Xero pair shows engine link.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Control panel 'Run reconciliation poll' and day advance catch the seeded missed-webhook payment.
items.verify_note: Confirmed Status: Confirmed item; re-read poll and receivePayment. 'Ledger as system of record' (US-08.3.2) is an EP-08 gap; here the BillingCase mirror stands in. Confidence stays medium for that reason.
items.title: Reconcile back to the ledger

items.summary: The prototype has no bulk-payment or bank-reconciliation representation: the Xero simulator pays one invoice at a time and has no reconciliation or unmatched-items view, so the boundary (Xero's add-on matches bulk remittances; leftovers stay in Xero for the office) is not shown. Not OutOfScope because a simulator view can make it presenter-explainable.
items.requirement_says: Bulk hospital payments covering multiple invoices are matched by Xero's own bank reconciliation and remittance add-on, not the Billing/Invoice Engine; any item the add-on cannot match stays as an unmatched item in Xero's bank reconciliation for the office to handle there.
items.prototype_does: Nothing that shows it. Payments reach the engine only as single-invoice webhook or poll events (full or half). The only related text is Xero-sim copy that the engine's InvoiceNumber is the key hospitals and insurers quote on remittances so remittance matching can key on it. Xero sim has Contacts and Invoices tabs only. The engine does no bulk matching (consistent with the requirement), but nothing shows Xero doing it or the unmatched leftovers.
missing_or_wrong: No simulated bank feed or Xero bank reconciliation view
No bulk payment covering several invoices (one bank line, several ACCRECs) that Xero's add-on matches by reference and amount before the engine sees it
No unmatched line left in Xero for the office, and no 'what to do' hint for a receipt with no reference
evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/demo/DemoXero.tsx:66,548,718 (InvoiceNumber as remittance matching key; copy only)
searched: remittance|bank reconcil|bank feed|unmatched in src -> only DemoXero copy; 'unmatched appointment' integration wording is unrelated
items.demo_trigger: On /demo/xero add a 'Bank reconciliation' tab and a badged (Demo simulation) button 'Receive bulk hospital payment': one bank line covering three open ACCRECs from the same hospital, matched by the remittance add-on (reference and amount) so the engine then receives three normal payment events, plus one bank line with no reference left 'Unmatched in Xero' for the office. Optional second button 'Office matches line'.
items.verify_note: Searched for remittance, reconciliation, bank feed and unmatched wording; only the DemoXero InvoiceNumber copy exists, which supports the key but not the story's behaviour, so Missing (not Partial) stands. Challenged OutOfScope: a simulator tab with a bulk line and an unmatched line is a concrete trigger, so not OutOfScope. Status Proposed; the Technical discussion says parking of unplaceable receipts is unsettled, so the unmatched line should stay 'left open in Xero' without a holding-account claim.
items.title: Bulk remittance stays in Xero

items.summary: No negative invoices to anaesthetists, no netting in a payment run, no remittance advice; negative invoice totals are refused.
items.requirement_says: A negative invoice (refund or credit after invoicing) is netted against the anaesthetist's positive payables in the next payment run (19 positive + 1 negative = pay net); remittance advice shows the negative netted against the positives.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. buildInvoicesForBooking refuses a negative group total as 'negativeTotal'; runPayables disburses only positive authorised increments, one Disbursement per ACCPAY; no credit note, refund, netting or remittance entity; anaesthetist apps have no remittance view.
missing_or_wrong: No negative invoice / credit-driven negative payable entity
Payment run does not net negatives against positives; pays per payable, not a per-anaesthetist net total
No remittance advice (per run, per anaesthetist) in web, mobile or admin
No demo way to create a refund/credit after the anaesthetist is paid
Depends on credit-after-invoicing flow US-08.6.2 (absent) as the source of the negative
evidence: searched (re-run): remittance|refund|credit note|netting|negative in src (non-test) -> only comments, negativeTotal guard, CSS margins, a DemoXero comment about remittance matching key
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Raise credit on a paid invoice' on the admin invoice detail (creates a negative invoice to the anaesthetist), then 'Run payables' on Billing monitor pays the net and shows a Remittance advice panel (invoices, negative netted, net total) in Admin and Dr Souter's Web Accounts.
items.verify_note: Searched broadly for refund/credit/netting/remittance variants; only the refusal guard and unrelated hits. No implementation missed.
items.title: Negative invoices netted in the payment run

items.summary: The acceptance criterion holds in effect (a DRAFT, unauthorised payable is never in the run), but there is no explicit approval of a period's BCTIs: BCTIs are per-procedure ACCPAYs with no payment-period batch, approve step or 'approved for payment' wording. Status Verify; OQ-47 and the story note leave open whether this is the same step as US-10.2.1.
items.requirement_says: Once AA has generated the BCTIs for a payment period, they are approved for payment before being paid out; BCTIs not yet approved are not in the payment run. Who approves and how is unknown and may simply be the US-10.2.1 release.
items.prototype_does: Each ACCPAY (the BCTI, one per procedure) starts DRAFT and becomes AUTHORISED automatically when its receivable is paid; runPayables and payablesDue include only authorised minus disbursed amounts, so an unapproved (DRAFT) payable is never in the run. No approval list or approve action, no payment-period grouping, no 'approved for payment' wording; Xero sim shows Authorised/Disbursed amounts only.
missing_or_wrong: No explicit 'approved for payment' state or step distinct from authorisation, and no admin or system approve action for a period's BCTIs
No payment period (ISO week or month) batching BCTIs for approval (depends on the unbuilt weekly cycle, US-10.2.7)
Approval is purely a side effect of receipt; nothing tells a presenter 'not approved, so not in this run'
If approval is settled as the same step as US-10.2.1 authorisation, only labelling (BCTI approved for payment, excluded-from-run list) is missing
evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/bcti.ts (BCTI = the procedure ACCPAY; no period approval)
searched: approv.*BCTI|approved for payment in src -> none
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Demo actions > 'Payment received · full' releases (approves) a payable. If a separate approval is kept after OQ-47: an 'Approve this week's BCTIs' control on the Billing monitor payables card that moves the period's released payables to Approved for payment, listing unapproved ones as excluded from the run.
items.verify_note: Checked the single AC against payablesDue/runPayables: unapproved payables are excluded, so the AC is satisfied in effect, but the story is about an explicit approval of a period's BCTIs, which is not represented; and the story is Verify with the same-step question open. Considered Matches (Xero's AUTHORISED status is literally 'approved') but the missing period batching and wording keep Partial. Size S stays only if approval equals release; M if a separate approve step and period batch are wanted.
items.title: Approve the period's BCTIs for payment

items.summary: No weekly payment cycle: no ISO-week identity on runs/disbursements, no Friday close/reconcile, Monday check, Tuesday schedule, or anomaly hold and roll-forward. Run payables is a single immediate manual action.
items.requirement_says: Payments run on a weekly cycle named by ISO week (Friday ledger close/snapshot/reconcile, Monday office working day, Tuesday payment schedule to the accountant, anomalies rolled into next cycle). A payment is shown against its cycle's week number; an anomaly not fixed by Tuesday is held out of this cycle's schedule and rolled forward. Status Proposed, still to confirm with accountant (OQ-47).
items.prototype_does: Nothing for the cycle. runPayables creates Disbursements with payablesRunId (PR####) and clock time only (types.ts:824). ISO week number appears only as a label in the admin RightRail (RightRail.tsx:60,128), unrelated to payments. Demo clock is fixed at Tuesday 21 July 2026 8:00; no advance control found.
missing_or_wrong: No payment cycle/week entity or ISO week label on runs, disbursements, or the web/admin payment lists
No Friday close/snapshot/bank reconciliation step
No Monday anomaly list or ability to hold a payable out of the run and roll it to next cycle
No Tuesday payment schedule (view/export for accountant)
Run payables not tied to a cycle day; seeded historical disbursements have no week
Payment lookup does not show week number (acceptance criterion 1 unmet)
evidence: searched: isoWeek|payment cycle|accountant|anomal|friday|roll(ed) forward in aa-prototype/src non-test -> only RightRail week label and unrelated canvas.rollForward

items.verify_note: Re-searched for cycle/week/schedule/hold vocabulary; only the unrelated calendar week label exists. Missing upheld. Note demoTriggers.test.ts:54 asserts no demo trigger labelled 'payables'; a cycle control needs a differently-labelled trigger or a test change.
items.title: Weekly payment cycle

items.summary: One 'Run monthly fee invoices' action raises every active anaesthetist's fee invoice from the fee settings and tracks each as an AA fee ACCREC and fee-invoice record, separate from procedure receivables/payables; 40 BCTIs at $500 + $5 gives $700 ex GST.

items.prototype_does: Admin AA fees > Fee invoices: month stepper, per-anaesthetist preview, 'Run monthly fee invoices' (rerun is a no-op, no future months); each invoice snapshots settings and counted BCTIs and creates a kind 'aaFee' ACCREC with no ACCPAY, shown in the Xero simulator and web AA fees; 'Seed a month of BCTIs' tops Dr Rutherford to 40 paid BCTIs giving $700 ex GST ($805 incl GST).

items.verify_note: Checked the AC arithmetic against seed fixed items (500) and $5 per BCTI (=$700 ex GST). 'Tracked in the ledger': the prototype tracks it as billing.aaFeeInvoices plus a Xero ACCREC; the internal ledger-pair view is the separate Phase 36 and a different requirement, so not counted here. OQ-60/112 open but do not change the AC.
items.title: Generate AA fee invoices

items.summary: Admin fee settings tab edits several fixed items plus the per-BCTI charge, stored in appSettings and used by the next run; earlier invoices keep their snapshot.
items.requirement_says: Admins maintain fixed fee items (several allowed) and the per-invoice charge on a settings page; the monthly run uses them: total = fixed items + rate x BCTIs, and a rate change applies from the next run.
items.prototype_does: AaFeesScreen Fee settings tab: add/remove fixed items (description + amount), charge per BCTI, validation, live worked example for 40 BCTIs; saveAaFeeSettings (office only) writes appSettings.aaFee; runMonthlyFeeInvoices reads appSettings.aaFee at run time, so a changed rate affects only later runs; seeded schedule labelled sample pending the accountant (OQ-60).
items.verify_note: Both ACs checked against code: total is fixedItems sum plus rate times count (aaFeeFor); the new rate is read at run time and old invoices keep their snapshot. Per-anaesthetist variation of fixed items is unknown (OQ-60) and not required by the ACs. No demo trigger needed: settings are directly editable in the UI.
items.title: AA fee settings

items.summary: NHI dedupe works, but NHI is optional (provisional patients), payer is a route-driven BillableParty record, insurer is a master flag that bills directly, and the balance alert is only a billing-monitor tag.
items.requirement_says: One record per patient keyed on a mandatory NHI; each Booking names a payer (default patient, editable) billed when the Contract does not bill its holder; the Booking names insurer/funder as a Party plus approval number; admins see patient balances and are alerted on re-booking, anaesthetists see the alert on their List.
items.prototype_does: upsertPatient reuses by NHI but creates a provisional patient when NHI is blank. Payer is a BillableParty chosen only when the Procedure's billingRoute is billableParty; insurer is a master with acceptsDirectClaims and route 'insurer' bills it directly. Only a 'Prior balance' pill in the admin Billing monitor; no patient balance view, no booking-time alert, nothing on the anaesthetist List.

items.summary: Who is billed is decided by a per-Procedure billing route and by the resolved Contract's holder (including a surgeon), not by a Contract 'bills its holder or the payer' setting; no event-level billable party.

items.prototype_does: counterpartyForProcedure returns insurer on route=insurer, billable party or patient on route=billableParty, else the resolved Contract's holder (hospital, insurer, surgeon, organisation, billableParty). Contract has no bills-holder setting and no Party entity with delivery details. Insurer acceptsDirectClaims gates direct billing.

items.summary: Both NHI formats are validated by one pure module with the right shapes and check characters, wired into booking creation, PDF ingest and an admin validator. Only the 'modulus 24' label for the current format differs, a deliberate documented ruling.
items.requirement_says: Validate current (AAANNNC, text says modulus 24) and new (AAANNAX, modulus 23) NHI formats; never assume numeric or sequential; working before 1 July 2027.
items.prototype_does: domain/nhi.ts validateNhi detects format by character class, checks current format by weighted mod 11 (the real Health NZ algorithm; RFP's own example ZAA0067 only validates under mod 11) and new format by mod 23, rejects I and O, gives plain reasons; generateNhi makes non-sequential seeded NHIs of both formats. Integrations Validators tab shows an NHI validator and says on screen that the RFP's 'Modulus 24' label does not fit its own examples.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Admin, Integrations, Validators tab accepts ZAA0067 / ACA31FM and rejects a bad check digit.
items.verify_note: Read nhi.ts algorithms. Catalogue literally says modulus 24 for the current format but the prototype uses mod 11 by prior ruling and flags it on screen; behaviour a presenter shows (both formats validated, bad check rejected) satisfies the story, so kept Matches with medium confidence. If the catalogue wording is ever treated as binding this would become Contradicts, but switching to mod 24 would reject real NHIs.
items.title: Dual-format NHI validation

items.prototype_does: Seeds 14 anaesthetists (cast.ts ANAESTHETISTS) with AM and PM Slots over the horizon (appSettings.schedule.horizonMonths, range 1 to 24, settable). volumeStory { invoicesPerYear: 28000, activeContacts: 9820 } is narrated as counters on the Xero simulator and admin masters view, not generated records. listIndexBySlot is memoised 'so a 20,000-Slot grid never scans Lists per cell' but nothing builds or times that scale. Demo Data shows entity counts and storage size only. No performance readout anywhere.
missing_or_wrong: No full-scale dataset (85 anaesthetists, about 20,000 Slots, about 28,000 invoices)
No timing or performance readout for Day view, availability grid or invoice list at scale
Persisted state has a 5 MB budget, so a scale dataset must be in-memory and bypass persistence
evidence: searched: 28,?000|20,?000|performance.now|perf in src -> only comment, volumeStory, boot metrics in pwa
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Load full-scale dataset (85 anaesthetists, 20k Slots, 28k invoices)' on the Demo Data screen (/demo/data): swaps in an in-memory generated dataset (not persisted) and shows load/render timings for the Admin Day view, availability grid and invoice list; 'Back to demo data' restores the seed.
items.verify_note: Re-searched for scale/perf code; none beyond narration. Seed cast confirmed at 14. Horizon setting confirmed configurable. Trigger and size look sensible; an in-memory-only generator is the sound approach given the 5 MB persistence budget.

items.requirement_says: Fee, unit, split and pricing logic is pure and deterministic and covered by automated tests with worked examples, so rules can change safely; cutover and parallel-run reconciliation validate tiered time and split billing against expected values.
items.prototype_does: All billing maths is in aa-prototype/src/domain/billing (fee, timeUnits, modifierUnits, contracts, invoiceBuild, bcti, aaFee, payableRelease, prePaymentInvoice, validateBookingForBilling), each with a test file (about 145 test cases in total); domainPurity.test.ts forbids React/store/theme/apps imports in the domain; billing sources contain no Date.now/new Date/Math.random (only test files use new Date with literal arguments).
