items.summary: NHI-never-to-Xero is implemented and tested, admin dead-letter rows show only patient name and a plain reason, logs carry no NHI; but there is no restricted-access raw-payload control, no synthetic-data / non-production statement beyond a 'fictional' note, and no broader leak scan.
items.requirement_says: NHI stays in clinical and ledger systems and is never sent to Xero or any finance platform in any field. It must not leak via logs, errors, monitoring or non-production environments: failed HL7 messages show office staff only what is needed to resolve the problem, with the raw payload under restricted access; non-prod holds only synthetic data; no client data in AI tools.
items.prototype_does: Xero contacts and invoice pairs key on the hidden internal ContactNumber; Xero simulator has a 'No personal information in Xero' callout; xeroNhi.test.ts scans the serialised Xero slice for NHI, names, phone, email and address after a full money chain. Admin IntegrationMonitorScreen lists dead-letter rows with patient name, status and a plain failure reason (no NHI, no raw HL7) plus Reprocess; failure reason strings contain no NHI. Console logging is limited to generic text with ids. Seed patients are fictional and the More tab says figures are fictional. The raw HL7 with the full PID segment is shown unrestricted in the /demo/integrations simulator (a demo-only surface).

No visible synthetic-data / non-production badge or presenter statement of the Dev/Test/UAT rule (only a 'fictional' sentence on the mobile More tab)
No NHI leak scan beyond the Xero slice (logs, error messages, audit summaries, monitoring); no-AI-tools rule is process-only and not representable
evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/screens/IntegrationMonitorScreen.tsx:119-135 (row shows patientRef = patient name, failureReason, Reprocess)

items.verify_note: Verdict and size upheld. Dropped the reviewer's 'audit log stores NHI (intake.ts:118)' point: the audit trail is held in the core platform where the NHI lawfully lives and the requirement bars logs, errors and telemetry that leave it, so it is not a real defect. items.summary: There is no sign-in session to go stale: all apps read one reactive persisted store, so an office change (admin edit or a hospital reschedule via the integration simulator) shows in the anaesthetist's List and Booking at once, and after back-navigation or refresh. Mechanism is Verify (unagreed with AA) but both acceptance criteria hold.
items.requirement_says: When the office changes a Booking or List (or a hospital change arrives), the anaesthetist sees it without signing out and back in, at the latest on returning to the List and reopening the Booking or on refresh; live update on an open screen is not required.
items.prototype_does: Mobile and web read store selectors, so a Booking edited in Admin or rescheduled via the integration actions appears in the mobile List and Booking detail with no sign-in concept; localStorage persistence (resilientLocalStorage) retains the change across a page refresh. No pull-to-refresh, refresh button or background polling exists, and none is needed as state is never stale. In the standalone PWA there is no office edit control (the office simulation only authorises Lists).
items.demo_trigger: Optional, PWA only: a demo chip 'Office changes this Booking's time' on the mobile Booking detail, editing the start time as the office actor so the presenter goes back to the List and reopens the Booking to show the new time. In the framed prototype the Admin app and HL7 simulator already cover this.
items.verify_note: Verdict upheld. Corrected size from S to None: a Matches item has no gap, and the PWA chip is an optional presenter convenience (relates to US-15.0.3), not a missing criterion. Also confirmed the hospital-change path exists in integrationActions. Dropped the 'no refresh affordance' point from gaps because the mechanism is not agreed and the story does not require one.

summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype is the July RFP model with Phases 15 to 32 layered on. Calendar, Slots, Lists, Draft Lists, pairings, tiers, warnings engine, the AA fee run and the Xero simulation are close to the catalogue. Money and intake are not. Of roughly 235 graded items, about 40 Match, about 25 are Partial, about 15 are Missing, and the rest are Contradicts or Grouping. Contradicts dominates EP-02 to EP-08, EP-11 and EP-12: the prototype implements a different, superseded design there, not a smaller version of the new one. EP-01, EP-10 and most of EP-13 are near done. The core is one coordinated rework: Contract (holder, dated versions, lines, flags) replaces billing route plus Type 1/2/3. Pricing, completion, prepayment, invoicing, payer, review and events all hang off it. Statuses were not used to scope work; they appear below only where an open question (OQ) makes a gap unsafe.

### Themes

**1. Contract-centred billing (XL).** Billing route, optional governing Contract, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s go. In: holders with an is-billed flag, dated Contract versions with AA code, standalone lines, one AA-held No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review and submit, authorisation snapshot, filtered picker, anaesthetist may change Contract until AUTHORISED. Items: EP-04, FT-04.1 to 04.3, US-04.1.1 to 04.1.6, US-04.2.x, US-04.3.x, FT-03.4, US-03.4.1, US-08.1.1, US-07.3.1. DM-07, DM-09, DM-10, DM-48, DM-49, DM-57, DM-08, DM-16. RV-06, RV-11, RV-18, RV-32. Split into model and maths, versioning and staging screens, picker and booking setup.

**2. Pricing, units and modifiers (XL).** Price, rate and discount become values on the Procedure; no mandatory reason; Contract flag gates the anaesthetist; $0 gives a no-charge invoice; discount is its own invoice line; modifier units split above four; RVG becomes a hidden-key master (NZSA 2021, duplicate codes); modifiers become records with explanations, age pre-applied, ASA ordinary; out-of-range warns instead of blocking; completion rules reworked ("finish", not "handover"). Items: FT-05.1 to 05.4, US-05.x, FT-03.3, FT-03.5, US-03.3.x, US-03.5.x, US-03.6.1. DM-13, DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-46. RV-03, RV-04, RV-07 to RV-10, RV-21, RV-22, RV-38. Many S quick wins (NHI, wording, reason removal, make-primary).

**3. Hospital intake matching screen (XL).** Nothing exists: HL7/FHIR and PDF rows apply straight to Bookings. Needed: staged rows, match/create/Draft List/assign/reject, per-row change type, field differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits allowed until AUTHORISED, third feed (CPH) out of scope. Items: EP-02, FT-02.1, FT-02.5, US-02.1.1/2/4/5, US-02.5.7, US-02.3.1, EP-14 (boundary). DM-34, DM-51. RV-12 to RV-16.

**4. NHI mandatory and source text (M, tied to 3).** Remove provisional patients and "NHI pending"; waiting-for-NHI queue with urgency; text exactly as received per source plus a separate invoice description. Items: US-11.1.1, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5, US-03.1.5, US-03.1.9, US-08.4.6. DM-30, DM-51. RV-20.

**5. Prepayment and holding account (XL).** Trigger is a prepaid Contract, amount is the line price, admin approval plus letter, payable to a holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Today the anaesthetist is paid before the procedure. Items: EP-06, FT-06.2 to 06.5, US-06.x, FT-08.1, FT-08.3, US-08.2.2, US-08.3.1, FT-09.1, US-09.1.1, US-09.1.3. DM-20, DM-21, DM-22. RV-05, RV-24.

**6. Events, additional invoices, credit notes (XL).** Post-op addendum Booking is replaced by events on the Procedure, additional free-form invoices, credit-in-full-then-rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly cycle. Items: FT-03.7, US-03.7.x, US-05.5.2, FT-08.6, US-08.6.1 to 08.6.5, US-10.2.6. DM-17, DM-18, DM-24, DM-25. RV-23.

**7. Edit window and anaesthetist views (M).** Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED; a List leaves the main view at AUTHORISED (not billed); balances show invoices immediately; search by name/NHI/date; scroll back. Items: EP-07, FT-07.2, FT-07.4, US-07.2.1, US-07.2.3, US-07.4.1, US-07.4.2, US-03.1.6, US-03.1.7. DM-55. RV-19.

**8. OQ-81 reversal (M to L).** Unavailability is never a conflict; closed sessions not assignable by the office; sickness takes return-or-assign to a Draft List. Items: US-01.5.2, US-01.5.4, US-01.6.3, US-01.5.5, US-01.4.1. DM-56. RV-25.

**9. Single-Booking move and notification pool (M).** Anaesthetist moves one Booking by creating a List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an "ask the office" source. Items: US-01.4.7, US-01.4.6, US-01.4.2, FT-13.8, US-13.8.1 to 13.8.3, US-03.6.3. DM-42, DM-41. RV-26, RV-27.

**10. Payer, insurer, balances, warnings (L).** Payer name and email on the Booking; insurer and approval number on the Booking; patient balance alerts at 90 days; remaining warning rules; admin whole-ledger views. Items: EP-11, FT-11.2 to 11.4, US-11.2.2/3, US-11.3.2, US-11.4.x, US-13.7.1, US-07.2.2. DM-11, DM-12, DM-23, DM-31, DM-28. RV-30, RV-31, RV-36.

**11. Profile, reports, admin polish (M).** Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST report of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing orders candidates, audit excludes payments, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. Items: FT-12.1, FT-12.2, US-12.1.1, US-12.2.2, US-13.4.1, US-13.4.3, US-13.5.2, US-13.5.3, US-13.6.4, US-15.0.1, US-15.0.4, US-15.0.6. DM-29, DM-32, DM-35, DM-38, DM-45. RV-02, RV-33, RV-35.

### Structural first

Screen work built before these lands is rebuilt twice. Suggested order:

1. DM-13 (RVG group, hidden key), DM-48 (holders), then DM-07, DM-09, DM-49 (Contract versions, lines, No contract) in one step with DM-46 (remove BillingLine). Then DM-10 (Procedure picks Contract and line), which unblocks DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-08 and DM-11.
2. DM-22 (internal ledger with its own payable) before DM-21 (holding account) and DM-20 (prepaid trigger); DM-17 (events) before DM-18, DM-24, then DM-25.
3. DM-30 (NHI required) and DM-51 (source text) before DM-34 (matching rows).
4. DM-57 (staged Contract changes) after DM-07 and DM-09.
5. Independent, can run any time: DM-55, DM-56, DM-42, DM-41, DM-32, DM-12. DM-29 follows DM-22. DM-45 is a policy note, fold into DM-07 or DM-24.

Every seed or type change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump, canvas-golden and seed tests refreshed. About 26 non-test files read governingContractId or billingRoute, so DM-10 is the widest change.

### Remove or rework (reverse check)

- Remove: attachments on Bookings and Lists (RV-01, M); GST period (RV-02, S); rate x time billing and Method 3 flag (RV-03, M; keep fixed ancillary lines until events exist); ACC "should not bill patient" review flag (RV-37, S).
- Rework (large): prepayment category and split (RV-05), default Type 1 fallback (RV-06), billing-time re-resolution (RV-11), route plus Type model (RV-18), prepaid pair paying anaesthetist (RV-24), addendum Booking (RV-23), HL7 auto-apply and third feed (RV-16).
- Rework (small to medium): price reason and flag (RV-04), ordinal pricing (RV-07), modifier split (RV-08), P1 absorption (RV-09), range hard bound (RV-10), completion rules (RV-21), ASA seeding (RV-22), unavailability conflict (RV-25), notice caption and OQ-84 hint (RV-26), office write-through with no Save (RV-28), per-Procedure payer (RV-30), line-level funder split (RV-31), in-place Contract edits (RV-32), GST receipts (RV-33), ageing buckets (RV-35), prior-balance pill (RV-36), modifier master values (RV-38).
- Hide from demo: Surgeon PDF tab (RV-12, no Future badge), automated change behaviours (RV-13), Productivity and Leave panels (RV-34).
- Keep as scaffold: reliability tooling residue (RV-15), photo capture (RV-17).
- Owner questions, not defects: office single-Booking move targets (RV-27); anaesthetist seeing no price (RV-29, Donald's own 28 Sept decision, conflicts with US-03.1.2 and FT-03.5).

### Demo impact

- S1: Beat 1 (Fire hospital message creates the Booking, "arrives in a later build") rewrites around the matching screen. Beat 3 capture changes: optional numeric RVG codes, no ASA seeding, modifier explanations, "finish" wording, Contract line on screen.
- S2: Beats 1b, 3 and 3a (sickness conflict, assign to closed session) change with OQ-81. Phone-advice beat needs the optional "as given" text and mandatory NHI. Beat 3c (own move) gains single-Booking move. Beat 4 and "submit sheet" copy change with the until-AUTHORISED edit rule; review screen content changes. Notification beat loses busy-morning paging.
- S3: billing Beats 1 to 2 (payer/route wording, pair), split-billing and two-funder beats, payables beat if the prepay payable moves to the holding account, GST and balances messaging (invoices now immediate).
- S4: Beat 1 (prepayment warning, Annette Riley), Beat 2 (post-op addendum, explicitly interim), billing failure and retry (relies on default fallback and un-end-dating), dead-letter and feed-mapping beats (CPH feed).
- Compliance tour: Contract effective-dating beat (edit in place becomes a new dated version), ASA edit seeding units, Master data Contracts click paths. Cheat sheet lines on "default Type 1", billing route, "office-only edits" after submit, and "Prior balance" also need edits.
- Unchanged: FT-02.4 ad hoc add (bar NHI), S2 own-move line "nothing recalculated", most fee-run beats.

### Demo-trigger buttons

The product owner's pattern: screen-contextual buttons in the top control area. Roughly 55 items name a trigger; about half already exist and need repointing (Simulate sickness, Fire hospital message, Stage post-op scenario, Authorise List, Raise sample warnings, month-end fee run). About 25 need genuinely new buttons. Clusters:

- Intake: "Receive tomorrow's theatre list" (St George's, Southern Cross), "Receive a changed list", "Receive list with a missing NHI" on the matching screen (FT-02.1, FT-02.5, US-02.1.1/2/4/5, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5).
- Prepay and ledger: "Prepay holding account" card, "Approve and send" with letter template, "Mark procedure done", "Email patient: anaesthetist changed", cancel-refund (FT-06.4, FT-06.5, US-06.3.1, US-06.3.6, US-06.5.x, FT-08.3).
- Credits and events: "Run next billing run", "Credit and rebill", "Stage double payment", seeded events list (FT-08.6, US-08.6.2, US-03.7.3).
- Contracts: "Stage a price review" creating a future-dated version, then advance the clock (US-04.2.10).
- Stand-ins for colleagues or office: "Ask Dr X to make this session available" (US-01.6.3), "Office resolves alert" (US-03.6.3), "Colleague moves one of my Bookings" (US-01.4.7), "ACCPAY paid in Xero" (US-09.2.4).
- Warnings and balances: new samples for child payer, insurer with no Contract, balance (mild, strong, credit), out-of-range base units (US-13.7.1, US-11.3.2, US-03.3.1).
- Platform: "Load full-scale dataset", "Run NHI leak scan", "Run cutover data load", "Skip sign-in", approve-week's-BCTIs (US-15.0.4, US-15.0.6, US-13.4.3, US-13.5.3, US-10.2.6).
- No trigger needed: EP-05 pricing (seed scenarios instead: 3-procedure 7-unit Booking, discount Contract, flag-off Contract, $0 Booking).

### Uncertainty

Unsafe to build fully until answered:

- OQ-95 (modifier application, age bands): US-03.3.4, US-03.3.8, US-05.1.4, US-05.1.5, RV-22, RV-38. Build age and ASA changes as labelled simplifications.
- OQ-101 (RVG ranges, system code), OQ-102 (tier names), OQ-113 (colleague ordering): US-05.1.1, US-03.3.1, US-01.3.6, US-01.4.5.
- OQ-105, OQ-106, OQ-93, OQ-98, OQ-114, OQ-99 (surgeon arrangements, insurance filtering, flag purpose): US-04.1.5, US-04.2.1, US-04.3.2, US-04.3.3, FT-11.4, US-11.4.1. These gate the picker and who-is-billed, so DM-48 and DM-10 have a soft edge here.
- OQ-96, OQ-97, OQ-104, OQ-116 (prepaid price edits, part credit, price held on issued invoice, mixed Bookings), OQ-115 (refund route): EP-06 detail, FT-06.4, US-06.5.2, US-08.6.2. Build assumptions in the catalogue.
- OQ-100 (data load, upload) and OQ-103 (invoice description for RVG Contract): US-04.1.6, US-13.4.3, US-08.4.6.
- OQ-109 and OQ-13 (hospital feeds, formats): the matching screen's row shape, US-02.1.1, US-02.1.5. Build against canned rows.
- OQ-111, OQ-47, OQ-112, OQ-29, OQ-60, OQ-12: payables detection (US-09.2.4, hold), weekly cycle (US-10.2.6, US-10.2.7), fee run label, BCTI wording (US-09.1.4 placeholder only), ACC pre-op codes (US-05.5.2).
- OQ-85 and OQ-83: single-Booking move edges, sign-in (keep skippable).
- Catalogue inconsistencies to raise with the owner, not build around: US-01.5.4 AC "reassign clears a hospital-closure conflict"; US-03.3.4 locked versus US-05.1.4 not locked; US-15.0.1 "no Contract complexity" versus US-03.1.2; US-07.4.1 screenshot caption; US-04.2.10 relink versus authorisation lock.
- Items whose status is Open or Verify (for example US-03.1.9, US-03.3.1, US-03.4.1, US-03.6.1, US-01.4.6) were graded against their text; confirm before treating them as settled.

dataModelDeltas.title: The RVG group becomes the one master list (hidden key, type-ahead rows, modifier units, AA groups); there is no procedure list
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Base units sit on the RVG group (NZSA RVG plus AA's own), with hidden key, anatomy heading, base units above 0 (printed range shown, anaesthetist picks exact figure) and modifier units default 0. RVG groups are the one master list: no procedure list, RVG code optional on a Procedure, type-ahead shows code, description, base units, hand-maintained and audited. Since 5 Nov a Contract may name an RVG group as its default RVG code and states no base units itself.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: RvgCode keyed by code string (types.ts:919) with single or range base units; 34 demo rows, view-only Master Data table, no create/edit/retire. Procedure.rvgBaseCode scalar string (types.ts:870), required by validator unless a billing line exists (validateBookingForBilling.ts:130). No hidden key, duplicate-code rows, modifier units, AA groups or type-ahead showing base units.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Foundation for the pricing track. RvgCode gets hidden id, anatomy heading, modifier units; Procedure.rvgBaseCode becomes an optional group reference (22 non-test files); absorbsModifierCodes moves to DM-44. Seed needs real NZSA list; picker gains type-ahead rows. Must precede DM-09 (default RVG code), DM-43, DM-44.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-05.1.6 is Retired and cited only as the reason there is no procedure list. Code re-read: RvgCode (types.ts:919) keyed by code, 34 seed rows, validator :130.

dataModelDeltas.title: The contract holder becomes a Party master (hospital, insurer, funder, surgeon or surgeon group, anaesthetist, AA) holding billing name and details and invoice delivery; the Insurer master and billable-party holder go
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Party is the shared record for anyone who holds Contracts: short name, kind (hospital, insurer, funder, surgeon/group, anaesthetist, AA exactly one), billing name and details (required once it holds a Contract that bills its holder), invoice delivery (email/post for now; OQ-114), and a pointer to the hospital master for hospital Parties. The Party is itself the billing record (no separate billable party). Insurer master and accepts-direct-claims flag retired; billed-or-not is a per-Contract setting, not a holder flag; practitioner links sit on each Contract, not the Party. AA's rooms are never a Party.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No Party. Contract.holderType (hospital|insurer|surgeon|organisation|billableParty) + holderId into four disjoint tables (types.ts:352,367,388); individualAnaesthetist scope is the only practitioner link (:379). Insurer master with acceptsDirectClaims (:338) gates the Insurer route (44 files mention insurers, 10 read the flag). No billing details or delivery output on holders; guardian BillableParty (:195) is a payer record, not a holder.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New Party master with CRUD and hospital link; Contract.holderType/holderId (10 files) become partyId; practitioner links move onto the Contract (DM-07). Insurer master and flag removed (seed, Master Data view, Insurer route in invoiceBuild and validator, booking sheets). Organisation holder becomes a surgeon-group Party; billableParty holder disappears. Delivery output built here (absorbs delivery half of old DM-16). Needed before DM-07, DM-49, DM-10, DM-11, DM-12.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.1.5 read in full and matches. Code: Insurer :338, ContractHolderOrganisation :352, ContractHolderType :367, Contract :388 confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Specialties become a master list: a surgeon holds one or more, a Contract holds none or several, and together they decide which Contracts are offered on a List
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: AA keeps a list of broad specialties (no subspecialties, audited, anaesthetists have none). A surgeon holds one or more, at least one, attached from AA's spreadsheet (D3; Ben said No to several so it stays at Verify). A List's specialties are its surgeon's. A Contract holds none (every specialty) or several; the step rail offers it only where its specialties include the List surgeon's, any overlap matching, no 'show all'.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Surgeon.specialty is an optional free-text string (types.ts:263), seeded for the cast and 131 directory surgeons and shown as a subtitle (20 non-test files mention it). No specialty master, nothing required or many-valued; Contract has no specialty field.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Specialty master with CRUD and audit; Surgeon.specialty becomes required specialtyIds (surgeon form, cutover load; map existing free text and directory seed; PERSIST_VERSION bump); Contract.specialtyIds (DM-07); candidate query in DM-10 reads both. Must precede DM-10.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Surgeon.specialty?: string at types.ts:263 confirmed; US-13.6.2 and the domain model say required list. The D3 versus Ben conflict is listed in the file.

dataModelDeltas.title: Funding tags become a master list a Contract may carry, placing a hospital-billed Contract under that tag on the step rail and letting the Booking's funder suggest a path
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: AA keeps funding tags (SXAP, HNZ, ACC, in step-rail order); a tag may name its funder, which lets the Booking's insurer or funder suggest a path. A Contract carries at most one; on a hospital-held Contract that bills the hospital it places it under that hospital at step 2. ACC is a tag, not a kind of Contract. One open-price fallback per hospital and tag.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing. ACC appears only in Contract names (seed/contracts.ts:83,108) and the informational Procedure.accRelated flag (types.ts:855); SXAP only as text.
dataModelDeltas.impact: FundingTag master (id, name, order, optional funder Party) with CRUD, Contract.fundingTagId, seed tags; step-2 derivation and Suggested path read it (DM-10); fallback generator keys on hospital plus tag (DM-49). Before DM-49 and DM-10.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-13.4.1 lists funding tags as maintained reference data; no FundingTag type exists in types.ts.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract becomes one flat priced item held by a Party, edited in place and audited, with a pricing kind, bills-holder-or-payer, prepaid, override and Active/Disabled status; Type 1/2/3, scope, versions, end dates, per-holder default and Method 3 gate go
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: 5 Nov flat model (Donald D1-D11, not yet confirmed by AA or Greg) replaces dated versions: a Contract is one priced item, no lines, versions, relinking or staged change; settings undated, a change is an audited edit, a from-date change means a new Contract and the old one Disabled. Fields: AA code, name, holder Party, bills holder or payer, funding tag, specialties, linked surgeons (0+) and at most one anaesthetist, prepaid (fixed for life, price >0, never RVG-priced, no override), anaesthetist-may-override (RVG kinds only; never fixed or prepaid), one of five pricing kinds, Active/Disabled, system role, holder reference code, invoice description, default RVG code. Retired: US-04.1.6, US-04.2.4, US-04.2.10; bulk upload Future. OQ-131 and OQ-100 answered; open OQ-133, OQ-135, OQ-136.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Contract (types.ts:388): type 1|2|3, holderType/holderId, scope, permitsIndividualArrangement, isDefault, effectiveFrom/To, type2Detail. No AA code, pricing kind, bills-holder-or-payer, prepaid/override flag, status, specialties, funding tag or multi-surgeon link. contractActions.ts already edits in place with audit (createContract :53, editContract :106), so no version series exists. Effectiveness judged on List date (contracts.ts:22); selection ranks individual>org>default (:34). 12 seed Contracts named by Type (seed/contracts.ts:45).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Schema rewrite of the master pricing, billing and review read (26 files touch governingContractId/billingRoute, 10 holderType). Needs DM-48 first, then DM-63, DM-64, DM-09, DM-49 in the same step. Replace effective dates with Active/Disabled, type/scope/isDefault/Method 3 with pricing kind, flags and links; add save-time guards (prepaid forbids RVG kind/override/zero price; fixed forbids override; links required; system Contracts undeletable). Seed re-authored one Contract per priced item. Version series, copy-lines, relink and staged change (old DM-57) no longer needed. The Method 3 gate field leaves here; the BillingLine entity waits for DM-17 (DM-46).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Retired US-04.1.6/04.2.4/04.2.10 are cited only as the reason versions and lines go. Code confirms in-place edit with audit (contractActions.ts:53,106) and no status or flag fields on Contract.

dataModelDeltas.title: A fixed-price Contract's dated price ranges replace ContractPrice, and a Contract carries an optional holder reference code, invoice description and default RVG code; there are no Contract lines
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: No Contract lines (US-04.2.4 Retired). A holder's schedule becomes one Contract per item; item code becomes the holder reference code (optional, not unique, searchable, printed on holder invoices), description becomes invoice description (a default for the Procedure's invoice description), optional default RVG code fills the Procedure's RVG code. A fixed-price Contract has one or more price ranges (start date, may be past; price ex GST, >0 if prepaid), no overlap or gap, range in force on procedure date prices; none in force means not offered. Time bands, alternative columns and combinations are separate Contracts; fee extras are events.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ContractPrice (types.ts:422): contractId, rvgBaseCode, surgeonId, procedureOrdinal, price; only Type 3 Contracts use rows, most-specific match (contracts.ts:77) with BTM fallback. No start date, reference code, invoice description or default RVG code; rate/discount on Contract.type2Detail (types.ts:384).
dataModelDeltas.impact: ContractPrice becomes PriceRange (contractId, startISO, price) with overlap-free guard and range-in-force lookup; rvgBaseCode/surgeonId/ordinal keys go (surgeon price becomes surgeon-linked Contract). Contract gains three optional fields. Replaces masters.contractPrices and matchContractPrice (14 files). Smaller than the line model it replaces. After DM-13 and DM-07; invoice description is top layer of DM-51.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: ContractPrice (types.ts:422) keys confirmed; no start date. US-04.2.4 Retired, cited as boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: One stored No contract · RVG held by AA, plus a system-made open-price fallback for every invoice destination, replace the protected default Type 1 per hospital and direct-billing insurer
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: No contract · RVG is the one built-in default: held by AA (never billed), RVG at the anaesthetist's rate with override allowed, no specialties/links, never disabled, found by system role, bills the payer, pinned first under Patient>Standard. Every invoice destination has exactly one system-made open-price fallback (No contract · Fixed price, Prepaid · Fixed price, one per hospital and funding tag, one per Special holder), never disabled or deleted, picked by the Other price toggle with the amount typed; the anaesthetist types amounts only on No contract · Fixed price. Partly reverses OQ-78.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Protected default Type 1 Contract per hospital and per direct-claims insurer, created with the hospital or when the insurer flag flips (mastersActions.ts:87,182), protected (contractActions.ts:28,111,157), used as fallback (invoiceBuild.ts:86,114). Billable Party route resolves with no Contract. No open price or Other price.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Delete per-holder default creation, protection and expiry fallback; add AA-held No contract · RVG found by role and a fallback generator over hospital+tag, Special holder and the two Patient destinations with a no-delete/no-disable guard. Payer-on-Booking billing replaces the Billable Party route (DM-11). Comes with DM-07; needs DM-48, DM-64. It does NOT wait on DM-50: the generator and guards exist without the typed amount, which arrives with DM-14 and DM-50 after DM-10 (otherwise DM-49, DM-50, DM-14, DM-10 would form a cycle).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Dependency cycle removed (DM-10 needs DM-49, so DM-49 cannot need DM-50 which needs DM-14 which needs DM-10). US-04.3.7 (Future Work) dropped from refs; FT-04.4, US-04.4.1, US-04.4.2 are Retired and kept only as the reason the per-holder default goes. US-04.3.3 and US-04.3.9 read in full and match.

dataModelDeltas.title: Each Procedure selects exactly one Contract at booking setup, picked on a step rail from the Contracts that fit its List; the billing route and billing-time Contract resolution disappear
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Procedure has exactly one Contract (no line) before completion; the office sets it at setup, on the decided step rail (US-04.3.8): where the invoice goes (Patient, the List's hospital, Special; derived, never stored), then Payment type (Standard/Prepaid) or the hospital's funding tag, then the Contract by typing or Other price. Candidates: Active, held by the List's hospital or linked to its surgeon/anaesthetist or an unlinked insurer/funder Contract, specialties include the surgeon's, fixed price has a range in force; no show-all; the Booking's funder only marks Suggested. 'Needs an invoice destination' until set. Anaesthetist may change Contract until AUTHORISED (audited, flagged); change clears a typed price; only office moves onto/off prepaid. A moved Booking keeps its Contracts, mismatches flagged at review (US-04.3.11).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure carries billingRoute (types.ts:831), governingContractId (:832), insurerId (:838), billablePartyId (:844), patientPaymentCategory (:846), prepaymentDetail (:848). Route must be set (validator :125). Office stores the governing Contract in OfficeBillingSetup; the run uses it if in effect else falls back to the route holder's default (invoiceBuild.ts:114). No step rail, no candidate filter by hospital/surgeon/anaesthetist/specialty, no Contract-change flag; reassignBooking ignores Contracts.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Central relationship change: Procedure.contractId (mandatory) replaces route, governing Contract, insurer (to Booking, DM-12) and payment category (26 files). Adds a pure candidate query (Contracts, Parties, List hospital/surgeon/anaesthetist, specialties, range in force) and a step-rail UI as views over Contract settings; anaesthetist Contract/RVG picker and change window; review flags for Contract change and no-longer-fits; moved Booking keeps Contracts. Needs DM-13, DM-48, DM-49, DM-63, DM-64, DM-07, DM-09; unblocks DM-43, DM-50, DM-08, DM-11, DM-20.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.3.8 read in full and matches (destination derived, never stored once a Contract is chosen). Code fields and validator line confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: Choosing the Contract and the RVG code fills in the Procedure's starting values; base units come from the RVG group, and an out-of-range value only warns
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Choosing the Contract fills the RVG code from the Contract's default RVG code where none is set; base units come from the RVG group alone (a Contract states none, OQ-62 overtaken), exact figure chosen where a printed range; modifier units start at 0 plus pre-applied. They become the Procedure's own values, any figure allowed, out-of-range only warns (OQ-56). Changing the Contract clears a typed price but keeps RVG detail. On fixed/open price no units are asked; RVG code reference only.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: resolveBtm (fee.ts:58) takes base units from the RvgCode row (single or range via baseUnitsSelected) with a flagged captured override (types.ts:154). No default-RVG fill, no reset on Contract change. Validator fails a missing or out-of-range selection (validateBookingForBilling.ts:152-165) instead of warning and demands an RVG code or billing line on every Procedure.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Smaller than the earlier line-layer reading: pure module change with tests (default-RVG fill, clear/keep rules, no units on fixed/open), validator branch becomes a warning (DM-31), capture UI refreshes on Contract/code change. Depends on DM-13 and DM-09 (and in practice lands with DM-10).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Validator range check confirmed at :152-165 (fails, does not warn).

dataModelDeltas.title: A Procedure's price follows its Contract's pricing kind until a person, a prepayment invoice or AUTHORISED holds it; five pricing kinds replace Type 1/2/3
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Five pricing kinds: RVG at the anaesthetist's rate, at the Contract's rate, RVG less a discount (own invoice line), fixed price (range in force on procedure date), open price (typed). B/T/M only on RVG kinds. Price at any moment, first match: AUTHORISED snapshot, prepaid amount once invoice raised, a typed price, else computed from the kind (so it follows a new range or edited rate/discount), else 'Needs a price' (blocks completion and AUTHORISED). Unedited price is derived, not stored. Contract change clears a typed price; 0 gives no-charge invoice; no automatic difference invoice; ex GST.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: feeFor (fee.ts:180): Type 1 units x unit value; Type 2 agreed rate or percent discount from Contract.type2Detail; Type 3 ContractPrice else BTM fallback (ordinal rule :212); non-RVG billing lines (:237); typed priceOverride last (types.ts:880). Price is always computed, never stored, but there is no price source, 'Needs a price' result or snapshot.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Rewrite pure fee path and Vitest suite on five kinds with a price-source ladder and a needs-a-price outcome read by completion and authorise guards. Procedure gains one typed-price field (not price/rate/discount). Invoice line text must stop being the only snapshot (DM-08). Depends on DM-07, DM-09, DM-14.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: feeFor confirmed: Type 2 rate/discount, Type 3 ContractPrice with BTM fallback, non-RVG lines, priceOverride last.

dataModelDeltas.title: Price changes become one typed price on the Procedure: the anaesthetist only on an RVG Contract that allows it or on No contract · Fixed price; the office on any Contract until AUTHORISED (prepaid until its invoice is raised); no reason, last change stands
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each RVG-priced Contract carries an AA-set override setting (OQ-107); price only, never rate/discount; never on fixed price (OQ-117) or prepaid (OQ-96). Anaesthetist types an amount only on No contract · Fixed price. Office can change any price on any Contract until AUTHORISED, except a prepaid price is read-only once its prepayment invoice is raised (A16, narrows 28 Oct). No reason; audited, flagged at review; last change stands; Contract change clears the typed price. BTM recorded in full on RVG kinds; the price is shown to the anaesthetist as they record (US-03.3.10).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: One optional Procedure.priceOverride (fixedFee, dollarAdjustment or percentAdjustment) with mandatory reason (types.ts:812,880), writable by anyone with edit rights via editProcedure (lifecycle.ts:452); OverrideCard and PriceOverrideSheet. No Contract override flag, actor distinction, reset on Contract change, review flag or post-invoice read-only state.
dataModelDeltas.impact: priceOverride and reason go; one typed price (DM-50) edited in place with actor audited; UIs and store gate on RVG Contract AND override flag AND not prepaid for the anaesthetist, No contract · Fixed price for an amount, office any Contract unless prepaid and invoiced; audit labels and review flag change (9 files). Depends on DM-07, DM-10.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: PriceOverride union at types.ts:812 confirmed; the prepaid-after-invoice narrowing is a recorded catalogue contradiction.

dataModelDeltas.title: Modifiers become per-Procedure records, each claimed one with an explanation; age and included modifiers are pre-applied but not locked; ASA is just a modifier
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Anaesthetist picks modifiers from the RVG modifier table plus AA's own, itemised, with a short explanation for each claimed one. System pre-applies only the age modifier (A1/A2 from date of birth) and modifiers included in a code's base units (P1 on Neurosurgery and Spine codes) at 0 units; none locked (Donald 20 Oct; OQ-95 open). ASA is one optional modifier. The modifiers step is asked only on RVG-priced Contracts; completing it with none is valid.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure.selectedModifierCodes (types.ts:868) plus asaClass (:866) seeding an AS code (fee.ts:79); modifierUnits zeroes absorbed codes with a refusal caption (modifierUnits.ts:58). No explanation field, no age modifier, no per-Procedure modifier record.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New record (procedure, modifier, units, explanation, origin chosen/age/included); modifier master gains non-numeric values and AA codes; RVG group's included link replaces absorbsModifierCodes; asaClass and refusal path go; completion adds the explanation rule; capture sheet rebuilt (17 files). Needs DM-13; feeds DM-15.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Modifier locking contradiction (US-03.3.4 versus US-05.1.4/05.1.5) is noted in the file; delta follows not-locked.

dataModelDeltas.title: Multi-procedure rule: one primary flag, time on every procedure, modifier units split above four, no Contract-specific ordinals; applies only to RVG-priced Procedures
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Exactly one primary Procedure, settable by anyone with edit rights. Base units only on the primary; time on every Procedure; modifier units all on the primary while total <=4, else split evenly with remainder to primary. No Contract changes it. Since 5 Nov it adjusts only RVG-priced Procedures; on a Booking whose primary is on a fixed/open price, base units go on no Procedure until OQ-132 is answered.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Base-on-primary and time-on-every already match (splitBillingUnits, fee.ts:107). isAdditional boolean (types.ts:863) with modifiers always on the first; no settable primary, no split above four; ordinal-keyed fixed prices (fee.ts:212); time tiers are constants (timeUnits.ts:13).
dataModelDeltas.impact: isAdditional becomes isPrimary (15 files); allocation step pure and testable and skips fixed/open-priced Procedures with a mixed-Booking test; ordinal pricing and seed rows go; tiers become data. Needs DM-44.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: splitBillingUnits confirmed: additional Procedure yields time units only.

dataModelDeltas.title: The BillingLine entity, rate x time billing and the Method 3 gate are removed; other late lines become events
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Rate x time capture is Retired; 'other billing lines' merged into events (DM-17); Contract add-on fees and lines are gone; fee extras in a holder's schedule are events or additional invoices with the amount typed (US-04.2.11). Time is recording only. A split between payers is a Booking action (DM-28).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingLine with ChargeBasis rvg|fixed|rateTime (types.ts:888,897), hours, rate, funderOverride; Contract.permitsIndividualArrangement as Method 3 gate (validateBookingForBilling.ts:222); seeded rate x time Booking; lines summed into the fee (fee.ts:237); add-line UI.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Whole BillingLine entity (26 files) replaced by events (DM-17) and the Procedure's price. Staged: the Method 3 gate field and its validator branch leave with DM-07 (Contract shape touched once); the BillingLine entity, rateTime basis, seeded scenario and UI go only after DM-17, which follows DM-10 and DM-08, so rate x time lines run ungated in between. Do the entity removal with DM-59.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Draft said 'build DM-17 first, then remove; do with DM-07', which contradicts DM-17 coming after DM-10 and DM-08. Split into the gate (with DM-07) and the entity (after DM-17). US-03.3.6, US-03.3.7 and US-04.2.4 are Retired and cited as the reason for the removal.

dataModelDeltas.title: Authorising a List snapshots each Procedure's Contract settings and pricing values; the billing engine reads the snapshot
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On AUTHORISED the engine snapshots per Procedure the Contract's settings as then (rate, discount, only the price range in force; Contracts have no versions), the Procedure's values, recorded BTM, unit rate, price and payer/billable party details. Later changes never alter an issued invoice. A Procedure with 'Needs a price' blocks AUTHORISED. No relinking: the earlier relink-versus-lock clash is gone.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: authoriseList (lifecycle.ts:275) only sets AUTHORISED. The run later resolves the Contract and computes fee at run time (invoiceBuild.ts:114,264; billingRun.ts:69), storing amounts and rate text in line descriptions (:247). No stored Contract settings or resolved values; InvoiceLine.procedureId optional (types.ts:1131).
dataModelDeltas.impact: New PricingSnapshot per Procedure written at authorisation, copying Contract settings and range in force (not a version link), read by the run and regeneration; lock covers Contract pricing; authorise guard refuses a Procedure with no price. Needs DM-07, DM-10, DM-50, DM-11. Per-Booking failure isolation stays.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: InvoiceLine.procedureId optional confirmed at types.ts:1131.

dataModelDeltas.title: A Procedure keeps the procedure text as received, the hospital's replacing the rooms' with each replaced text in the change history, plus an invoice description set by defaults (rooms, hospital, Contract) that an admin's edit always overrides
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Procedure text is exactly what the source sent (or typed as given), never hand-edited: starts as the rooms' text, the hospital's replaces it when it arrives, later updates replace again (on the matching screen); each replaced text kept in the Booking's change history with source and time (until 5 Nov both were kept side by side). Invoice description is a separate field set by defaults: rooms, then hospital, then the Contract's invoice description where filled; RVG plays no part. Admins edit it freely and an admin's edit always stands against later defaults or a Contract change (OQ-130 answered, Donald's ruling). Open: OQ-13.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: One editable free-text Procedure.description (types.ts:825) serving screens and invoice. IntegrationMessage keeps raw text (types.ts:1394) but the Booking does not; audit holds before/after but no source tag on texts. No invoice description, default order, admin-edit marker or Contract description.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Two fields on Procedure instead of an append-only list: procedureText (written only by intake paths, replaced text and source to the history) and invoiceDescription with origin marker and admin-edited flag; pure default function over the two texts and Contract description. Remove hand edit of procedure text; invoice prints invoiceDescription. Pairs with DM-13, DM-09, DM-34, DM-35.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Domain model Procedure section matches (hospital text replaces rooms'; admin edit always stands).

dataModelDeltas.title: Who is billed is a setting of the Contract: its holder Party, or the payer named on the Booking; this replaces the per-Procedure billable-party override and the billing routes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each Contract bills its holder (the holder Party pays AA) or the payer on the Booking; AA- and anaesthetist-held and every prepaid Contract bill the payer (our reading; OQ-73 back at Confirm). Every Booking names a payer prefilled from the patient, editable by office or anaesthetist to a parent, guardian, benefactor or trust; a billed payer needs an email or postal address; held on the Booking, kept for the life of the debt then archived; no guardian record; under-18 payer mild warning. Party is itself the billing record. One invoice per distinct billable party per Booking.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Per-Procedure billablePartyId override to a BillableParty guardian master (types.ts:195; createBillableParty billablePartyActions.ts:21) with its own Xero contact (:1215). Default payer is the patient on the Billable Party route; counterparty is a CounterpartyRef union (types.ts:148) chosen by counterpartyForProcedure (invoiceBuild.ts:192). No Booking-level payer, no bills-holder-or-payer setting, no email/postal rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Booking gains payer fields (name, email, NZ Post address, different-payer flag); counterparty resolution becomes the Contract's setting picking the holder Party or Booking payer; guardian BillableParty replaced by Booking payer (not repurposed); hospital/surgeon/insurer tables fold into Party (DM-48); contact rule needs a home; Xero keying stays on a hidden id (13 files read billablePartyId). Needs DM-48, DM-07, DM-10.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: BillableParty (types.ts:195) is a guardian payer record, confirmed; domain model 'Patient, payer and billable party' section matches.

dataModelDeltas.title: Splitting a Procedure's fee between payers is a Booking action with typed $ or % shares, not a line-level funder override
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On a Booking a button against a Procedure splits the invoiced fee between several billable parties, each share a typed $ or %, each invoiced its share. A user action, not a Contract or Procedure setting (US-04.2.12 Retired); separate from an additional invoice. Whether % must total 100 is open (OQ-68, OQ-23).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingLine.funderOverride (types.ts:908) with a conservation rule; office-only allocation via setBillingLineAllocation (billingLineActions.ts:138) and setProcedureFunderAllocation (:218). Grouping invoices by counterparty per Booking is built (invoiceBuild.ts:264).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replace line-level overrides with a per-Procedure shares record; validator and allocation sheet adapt; invoice grouping unchanged. Moves with DM-46 (BillingLine carries the override today). Needs DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.2.12 Retired, cited as boundary. funderOverride at types.ts:908 confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Booking carries the insurer or funder and the insurance approval number, editable by office and anaesthetist, who sees the number; the funder only suggests a path and a missing approval number on an insurer is the only insurance warning
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An insured Booking holds the insurer or funder (a Party) and approval number as Booking fields, shown on the matching screen, editable by office and anaesthetist (who sees the number itself, OQ-93 part 4). The funder only marks a path Suggested and never narrows the Contract list; SXAP/HNZ/ACC are funding tags on Contracts. A missing approval number is a warning, never a block, only for an insurer (not ACC or Health NZ; A42), the only insurance warning. 'Insurance acceptance' in the design is the approval number; no Insurer route.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: None. Procedure.insurerId (types.ts:838) is the payee of the Insurer route into the Insurer master; accRelated (:855) is informational. No approval number, no funder, no suggested path.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Booking gains insurer-or-funder (Party, after DM-48) and approval number, editable by office and anaesthetist, shown on matching screen, review and to the anaesthetist; insurerId stops being a route; one warning rule with DM-31 (insurer kind only). Picker takes funder only as a Suggested mark. Small.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Domain model Booking section matches; Procedure.insurerId and accRelated confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: The NHI is mandatory with no blank: a Booking cannot be saved without one, and an incoming row without one waits at intake
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every patient has an NHI from creation, no blank or pending state; the NHI is the identifier and dedupe key. A Booking cannot be saved without one; an incoming booking with none waits on the matching screen's unmatched queue, creating neither Booking nor patient, until the office adds it; waiting rows marked urgent as the date nears. A stub (not a Booking) shows on its List meanwhile (OQ-118; DM-58). Bookings searchable by NHI or name.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Patient.nhi optional (types.ts:173); upsertPatient creates a createdProvisional record when none given (intake.ts:52); UI prints 'NHI pending' (format.ts:86). Seed holds patients with no NHI (seed.test.ts:400). No waiting-row queue, save guard or NHI search.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Patient.nhi required; remove provisional path and 'NHI pending' (16 files); creation paths refuse or park a row without one; waiting rows live in DM-34's queue and draw a stub (DM-58); search by NHI or name; re-author seed patients that have a blank NHI.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Patient.nhi?: string and 'NHI pending' badge confirmed; seed has provisional patients.

dataModelDeltas.title: A single Booking moves to a colleague by creating a List in the colleague's free Slot; whoever submits a List did its procedures
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An anaesthetist can move a single Booking only to a colleague free in that Slot; the move creates a List in the colleague's Slot holding it, never into an existing List (OQ-85). Whoever submits a List did its procedures; a Booking done by someone else moves to a List of theirs and its payable follows; a prepaid Booking's payable is the AA Holding account so nothing moves. Colleagues shown by availability only (OQ-113). A moved Booking keeps its Contracts, mismatches flagged at review (US-04.3.11).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: reassignBooking (lifecycle.ts:574) moves a Booking between Lists; an anaesthetist may only move between their own Lists ('notOwnList'). The 5 Nov review items (Contract the anaesthetist changed, price typed on a non-open-price Contract, Contract no longer fits after a move, Procedure needing destination or price) are review flags, not warnings; a Disabled Contract flag is OQ-135.

dataModelDeltas.title: Prepayment: started by picking a prepaid Contract, amount is the Procedure's price when the invoice is raised, invoice generated on admin approval (optional), prepaid Procedures left off the final invoice with nothing deducted, and a Contract changed off prepaid cancels the prepayment
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Picking a prepaid Contract (Payment type Prepaid, or Prepaid · Fixed price with a typed amount) starts the prepayment, per Procedure. Prepaid is fixed for the Contract's life, always bills the payer, never RVG-priced, no override (our reading A2; OQ-73 back at Confirm). Amount is the Procedure's price when the invoice is raised (range in force or typed), >0, shown to the anaesthetist; office may change it until the invoice is raised, read-only after (A16); only office moves onto/off prepaid. Invoice generated on admin approval (optional step, switchable), pair is receivable from payer and payable to AA Holding account. No automatic invoice/credit after; final invoice leaves prepaid Procedures off, nothing deducted. Contract changed off prepaid after sent/paid = cancellation: paid refunded, sent credited (OQ-119).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Prepayment is Procedure.patientPaymentCategory selfFundedPrepayment plus prepaymentDetail full|split (types.ts:794,804,846,848), derived on the Billable Party route (selectors.ts:574). Office raises the pre-procedure invoice by hand (prepaymentActions.ts:52), no approval step; split deposit with a netting deduction line (invoiceBuild.ts:296-460); full prepayment invoices an estimated fee from feeFor, not a Contract price. Unpaid warning built (prepaymentUnpaid.ts).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Remove PrepaymentDetail, split path, payment category and the netting line; run skips prepaid Procedures while ranking all. Trigger and amount read from the prepaid Contract (flag/guards DM-07, ranges DM-09, fallback DM-49, payer DM-11), amount frozen at invoice raise via the typed-price field. Invoice gains a held-for-approval state (switchable setting) and letter template master. Only office moves onto/off prepaid. Before DM-21. Staging: the cancel-on-change half (credit or refund when a Contract changes off prepaid) needs DM-24's credit and DM-21's refund, so it lands after them; the rest does not wait.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Draft implied the cancel-on-change half could ship before DM-21 and DM-24 while calling their credit/refund. Staged. FT-06.1, US-06.1.1, US-06.1.2 (Retired) correctly excluded.

dataModelDeltas.title: AA Holding account: the prepayment's payable is a creditor in the payables sub-ledger, and a journal transfer moves it to the anaesthetist who did the List at authorisation
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A prepayment's payable is the AA Holding account, a creditor beside each anaesthetist (not a bank or Xero account), its balance all prepayments for procedures not yet done; money sits in the trust account. It is never paid itself; money leaves only through the system (journal transfer or system-raised refund); payments are made in Xero and tracked (OQ-111). At authorisation a journal transfer moves it to the anaesthetist who did the List. Cancelling a prepaid Booking or changing its Contract off prepaid after sent/paid automatically credits (unpaid) or refunds (paid) it (OQ-115, OQ-119). A moved prepaid Booking changes nothing. Open: release trigger (OQ-125).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No holding account. Soft cancel keeps the Booking and charges no fee (cancelBooking lifecycle.ts:362) but credits and refunds nothing. The prepayment ACCPAY is to the anaesthetist and released pro rata as money arrives (payableRelease.ts:16; paymentActions.ts:69), so the anaesthetist can be paid before the procedure.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Ledger creditor record for the holding account (one fixed payee); release rule holds the prepayment payable until authorisation then writes the transfer pair to the List's anaesthetist; cancel calls an automatic credit/refund (needs DM-24); only system actions move money out; draft Xero pair to a holding-account contact; balance in DM-23. Needs DM-20, DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: No holding-account concept in code.

dataModelDeltas.title: Events on a Procedure (pre-op, post-op, billing event, additional invoice, credit, refund) replace the post-op addendum Booking and the other billing lines
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An event is anything recorded against a Procedure after setup, listed on it in both apps: pre/post-op events (own date/time, time or fixed fee, invoice tick, same-as-Procedure billable party tick), billing events (free-form charge or credit), additional invoices, credits, refunds. A billable event is billed in the next run, never held for the Procedure's invoice: bundled with other lines for the same billable party where it can, else its own invoice (OQ-121). Events appear on no List. Fee extras in schedules are events. Open: AA's pre-op consult in its own room (US-03.7.4, OQ-138).

Late fee lines are BillingLines (billingLineActions.ts:46). No event record, invoice tick, billable-party tick or next-run rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New Event entity (procedure, kind, date/time, time or fixed fee, invoiced flag, billable party or same-as, invoice link); replaces addendum Booking (6 files) and post-invoice billing-line path; run picks up invoiced events, groups by billable party, else own invoice; one review step; both apps list them. After DM-10, DM-08; DM-18 and DM-24 are event kinds; DM-46 entity removal waits on this. AA room consult not modelled yet.

dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admin or the anaesthetist (own Procedure) adds a free-form invoice (description, quantity, amount; no Contract rules) to any billable party, traceable to the original, recorded as an event, through the review step, always an invoice of its own with own number, ledger pair, Xero pair and payable, billed in the next run (OQ-121). Uses: late charges, extra work after prepaid/fixed work, splitting a combined Procedure.

dataModelDeltas.title: A wrong invoice is credited in full then rebilled; the payable is reversed by a negative invoice

Reversal is a negative invoice to the anaesthetist netted in their next payment run and shown on remittance. A credit note is not a refund. Rebill may start from a draft copy. Credit and new invoices are events. Cancelling a prepaid Booking raises its credit/refund automatically.

dataModelDeltas.verify_note: BillingPipelineStatus has no credit state (types.ts:1137).

dataModelDeltas.title: The internal ledger holds both halves of each pair as its own records (including the holding-account payable), with the payable independent of Xero
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: For every invoice the engine creates a linked receivable and payable in its own ledger (system of record); Xero only mirrors ACCREC and draft ACCPAY. Tracks money in/out per patient and anaesthetist. Invoices in the anaesthetist's name with AA as agent; payable is a buyer-created tax invoice (count per procedure/payment/run unsettled, OQ-29). Control accounts (debtors, creditors) hold totals, sub-ledgers (patients; anaesthetists plus AA Holding account) hold detail and reconcile; trust account is the bank account. Whether our system or Xero sends invoices is a build choice.

The payable exists only as XeroAccPay in the Xero simulation (types.ts:1244); no ledger record of its own. '-P' number stored (:1250); no BCTI wording.

Foundation for DM-21, DM-18, DM-24, DM-23, DM-25, DM-29.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: XeroAccPay at types.ts:1244 confirmed; no ledger-side payable record.
